jobs.title: Program and Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Director of Student and Alumni Programs of the UCLA Ziman Institute for Real Estate and Urban Economics (ZI), the Program and Operations Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and supporting the execution of the Ziman Institute's major programs and events as well as marketing, course support, and general office operations. Major duties for this position will include: major event coordination and data management support for Ziman-supported student programs (Anderson, Undergrad, Law) and outreach programs (Levine Programs, Housing as Health Care, and Research); Faculty and course support for Ziman UCLA Anderson real estate curriculum courses; digital marketing including website editorial management and maintenance, social media management, and Ziman partner marketing requests; business transaction support, including processing non-employee reimbursements and serving as purchasing system back-up; office management; and administrative support to the Ziman Institute's Faculty Director. Programs and events will primarily be on-campus, however this may also include coordination of off-site events. Members of the Ziman Institute team assign short and long-term tasks on a daily basis. The incumbent must be able to independently prioritize tasks, plan, monitor progress and check quality; apply working knowledge of University policy and procedures; and exhaust creativity and resourcefulness to fulfill assignments as instructed. Independent interpretation, anticipation and problem-solving are required. The incumbent works with minimal supervision and is expected to complete projects without oversight, except where policy issues and exceptional situations arise. The incumbent will meet regularly with the members of the Ziman Institute team to provide updates and coordinate programmatic needs.

\*UCLA provides a full pay range. Actual salary offers consider factors, including budget, prior experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business considerations. * Excellent writing and editing skills to compose and proof professional level copy for e-mails, letters, proposals, briefings, invitations, announcements, website, as assigned. (Required)

* Demonstrated high level of analytical and creative problem-solving skills, highly efficient and organized. (Required)

* Proven interpersonal skills to effectively interact with the Center's various constituents, including corporations, industry professionals, faculty, students, and university administrators. (Required)

* Absolute discretion in the maintenance of confidentiality of donor information. Discretion in the maintenance and confidentiality of sensitive information, the ability to work under pressure and with frequently changing deadlines and ability to work well with others. (Required)

* Demonstrated skill prioritizing multiple assignments and achieving high productivity and work quality under rigid deadlines in a fast-paced environment, skill coordinating large scale, high profile, complex conferences and events. (Required)

* Ability to make independent judgement based on professional and academic expertise beyond the implementation of administratively proscribed rules, policies and guidelines. (Required)

* General knowledge and familiarity with constituent databases, e-mail marketing systems, and UCLA Purchasing systems. (Preferred)

* Demonstrated skill in providing quality customer service in high traffic environments. (Required)

* Skill communicating clearly and diplomatically to convey information to diverse constituencies in person, by phone and in writing. (Required)

* Demonstrated ability to work independently in fulfilling various tasks and completing assignments. (Required)

jobs.title: Program Coordinator I (Office of the Young Child - Mental Health Consultation Program)
jobs.description:
The City of Pasadena is currently seeking a Program Coordinator I who will work directly with Early Care and Education professionals, children, and families in the cities of Pasadena, Altadena, and Sierra Madre to provide targeted mental health consultation services to young children exhibiting social-emotional challenges. The Program Coordinator I will conduct weekly classroom observations in Early Care and Education (ECE) settings and lead focused debrief sessions with educators, children, and families. The Program Coordinator I will also conduct training with Early Care and Education professionals to meet the complex behavioral and emotional needs of young children.
  
  
The current vacancy is in the Office of the Young Child under the City Manager's Office.
  
  
**IDEAL CANDIDATE**
  
The *ideal candidate* for this position will possess expertise in early childhood mental health consultation or family support to manage the administrative and programmatic operations of the Infant and Early Childhood Mental Health Consultation Program, including conducting classroom observations and using findings to support staff, children, and families. Ideally, the successful candidate will also possess a Master's degree in psychology, social work, counseling or a related field with at least one year of experience in a clinical setting.
  
  
A licensed mental health professional is desired, but not required.
  
  
**This is a limited term, grant-funded position with current funding to October 2028. Current and future employment is dependent on available funding.**

**Essential Functions**
-----------------------

The major responsibilities of this position are listed.

* Plans, organizes, directs and evaluates the daily operations of the Infant and Early Childhood Mental Health Consultation Program; conducts classroom observations to assess classroom culture, daily routines, parent, staff and peer relationships, transitions, challenging behaviors and uses findings to support staff, child and family.
* Partners with consultees to support ongoing communication with caregivers about mental health, behavioral health, or developmental concerns related to their infant or young child.
* Develops written intervention strategies using a team approach to assist staff with positive behavior-support strategies to promote infants’ and young children’s optimal social-emotional development.
* Provides group and individual training on overall social and emotional wellness with specific topics related to infant and early childhood development, trauma-informed care, attachment, self-care, and other related topics.
* Evaluates program needs and develops an effective program; develops procedures within areas of responsibility and instruction materials to assist in accomplishing program goals.
* Develops and/or facilitates trainings and workshops on a range of early childhood mental health topics for consultation, such as typical development, social and emotional skills, problem solving, and preventing or managing challenging behaviors through co-regulation skills.
* Develops a mental health consultation model that is strength-based, culturally-affirming, and trauma-informed.
* Conducts consistent and ongoing consultation meetings/conversations, observations, assessments, and other consultative/therapeutic activities; as assigned performs special tasks involved in responding to an emergency event
* Uses a framework of promotion, prevention, and early intervention to promote mental health and resilience and prevent behavioral problems.
* Demonstrates sensitivity to linguistic, cultural, social, economic, individual, and role differences among the infants, young children, and families served.
* Develops effective public participation strategies and activities and establishes effective working relationships with community groups or representatives, or related agencies; makes presentations to community groups or participates on committees and task forces to interpret/exchange information and to assure cooperation in achieving goals.
* Performs activities necessary to facilitate development of City and community partnerships and collaborative efforts; provides staff support to community-based planning coalitions and committees.
* Prepares analytical papers, publications, newsletters, planning documents and administrative reports; assists in the development of goals, objectives, policies and procedures.
* Conducts needs assessments, research and analyzes statistical and other data; makes recommendations on administrative and operational problems, policies and procedures.
* Assists in the recruitment and selection of interns and volunteers; represents the City in the community and at interdepartmental, interagency and professional meetings.

**Qualification Guidelines**
----------------------------

**COMPETENCIES**
  
The following list represents the core competencies needed for success in this position.

* **Teamwork** - Collaborating with others to achieve shared goals.
* **Involving Others** - Engaging others for input, contribution, and shared responsibility for outcomes.
* **Relationship Building** - Establishing rapport and maintaining mutually productive relationships.
* **Self- Management** - Showing personal organization, self-discipline, and dependability Maintaining emotional stability and self-control under pressure, challenge, or adversity.
* **Presentation Skills**- Formally delivering information to groups.
* **Writing-** Communicating effectively in writing.

  
**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE**
  
Any combination of education and/or experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary for acceptable job performance would qualify. jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator**

**Latecoere Interconnection Systems**  
**Location**: Los Alamitos, CA  
**Department**: Program Management  
**Reports To**: Program Manager

**Introduction to Latecoere**  
Tier 1 to the world’s leading industry manufacturers, Latecoere serves aerospace with innovative solutions for a sustainable world. The Group operates in all segments of the aerospace industry (commercial, regional, business, defense and space) in two business areas: Aerostructures (doors, fuselage, wings and empennage, struts & rods) and Interconnection Systems (wiring, avionic racks, onboard equipment, electronic systems).

**Position Summary**

Latecoere Interconnection Systems is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Program Coordinator to support the execution of aerospace and defense programs. Reporting directly to the Program Manager, this role is responsible for coordinating program activities, maintaining schedules and documentation, tracking deliverables, and facilitating communication across departments to ensure customer commitments are met on time and within scope.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, enjoys working cross-functionally, and possesses strong project coordination and communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Program Manager in the planning, coordination, and execution of customer programs.
* Maintain program schedules, milestone trackers, action item logs, and status reports.
* Coordinate activities among Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Production, and Finance teams.
* Schedule and facilitate internal meetings, customer reviews, and program status meetings.
* Prepare agendas, presentation materials, meeting minutes, and follow-up actions.
* Monitor program progress and proactively identify scheduling concerns, risks, and open issues.
* Track and maintain customer purchase orders, program documentation, and change requests.
* Assist with new product introduction (NPI) activities and program launches.
* Support engineering change implementation and customer-driven program changes.
* Compile program metrics and prepare reports for management and customer reviews.
* Communicate delivery performance, schedules, and project status to customers through regular status meetings.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure commitments and deliverables are completed on time.
* Assist in the development and implementation of process improvements that enhance program execution and customer satisfaction.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Associate degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Two or more years of experience in project coordination, program coordination, customer service, production planning, supply chain, or a related role.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Familiarity with project management principles and scheduling tools.
* Knowledge of AS9100 quality standards and aerospace manufacturing processes.

**What You'll Bring**

* A customer-focused mindset.
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization.
* A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving.
* Ability to work independently while supporting team objectives.

**Physical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based with regular interaction on the manufacturing floor.
* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

**Compensation**

* $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

(Actual compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, education, skills, and business needs.)

**Why Join Latecoere?**

Join a global aerospace leader and play an integral role in supporting programs that help connect and power the world's leading aircraft platforms. At Latecoere, you'll work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

Latecoere is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for all employees.

* Manufacturing: 1 year (Preferred)

Role:

**About the Role**

Behind every well-organized department is someone who knows how to connect the details, anticipate what's needed, and keep important priorities moving. As the Administrative Coordinator at Southland Credit Union, you'll provide high-level administrative and operational support to our SVP of People & Culture while helping coordinate the projects, communications, and initiatives that support the broader department.

This role combines executive-level administrative support with presentation development, communications, and project coordination. You'll help manage priorities, prepare materials for leadership discussions, organize departmental activities, and ensure important follow-ups don't get lost. Your ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently, and bring structure to complex details will make you an important resource to the People & Culture team.

  
Major Duties and Responsibilities:

**Supporting Leadership and Keeping Priorities Moving**

You'll work closely with the SVP of People & Culture to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, organize leadership materials, and ensure discussions and follow-up items stay on track. You'll also draft and format correspondence, reports, and professional documents while maintaining organized departmental records and resources.

Being effective in this role means knowing how to look ahead. You'll anticipate administrative needs, navigate scheduling conflicts, manage competing priorities, and use good judgment when handling sensitive employee and organizational information. From coordinating appointments to tracking outstanding assignments, your organization and follow-through will help keep departmental priorities moving.

**Turning Information Into Clear, Professional Communications**

You'll use your organizational and creative skills to develop polished, executive-ready presentations, reports, and supporting materials for leadership discussions, departmental meetings, employee training, and organizational initiatives. You'll take information and data and translate them into clear, visually engaging materials that communicate priorities, support decision-making, and keep others informed.

You'll also help shape how People & Culture communicates with associates. This includes preparing employee announcements, newsletters, departmental updates, and informational resources, as well as creating presentation templates and maintaining SharePoint pages and intranet content. Whether you're preparing materials for a leadership discussion or helping communicate an employee initiative, accuracy, thoughtful presentation, and attention to detail matter.

**Coordinating the Work Behind People & Culture Initiatives**

People & Culture supports a variety of programs and initiatives that contribute to the associate experience, and you'll help coordinate the details that bring them together. You'll maintain project timelines, trackers, and status updates, follow up on outstanding deliverables, and coordinate logistics, communications, and materials for employee engagement programs, training sessions, recognition activities, and organizational events.

You'll also support the ongoing work of the department by helping prepare and maintain HR policies, procedures, forms, and resources. Compiling information, conducting research, and preparing reports will give the team additional support for planning and decision-making. You'll also assist with administrative responsibilities such as invoice processing, expense reports, purchasing, and budget tracking.

Success in this role means leadership has the organization and support needed to stay focused on priorities, departmental initiatives remain coordinated, and communications and materials are accurate and professionally prepared. Just as importantly, the people you support can rely on you to anticipate needs, take ownership, and follow through.

* Associate degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will also be considered.

* Know how to anticipate needs, manage competing priorities, and coordinate follow-up without needing every next step outlined.
* Communicate professionally and confidently, including when preparing correspondence and materials for leadership audiences.

* Have advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Are proactive, resourceful, adaptable, and interested in finding ways to improve administrative processes.

jobs.title: ECM and Community Outreach Coordinator - Bilingual
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

We seek a reliable and compassionate CHW to provide CHW and ECM services and conduct consistent Community Outreach to clients in the community. As a CHW, you will play a vital role in improving the health and well-being of individuals.

You will work closely with patients, families, and healthcare providers to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care that addresses the physical, emotional, and social needs of our clients. This position will assist in connecting individuals with health and community support services, playing a crucial role in helping people access the care and resources they need directly. The role involves providing CHW or ECM Services on the spot and conducting outbound calls to connect clients to resources.

**Responsibilities:**

**CHW/ ECM Services:**

1. Conduct patient assessments to identify health and social needs.

2. Develop personalized care plans in collaboration with patients, families, and healthcare providers.

3. Provide education and support on chronic disease management, healthy behaviors, and self-care.

4. Facilitate access to community resources, services, and referrals.

5. Coordinate care transitions and communicate with healthcare providers.

6. Conduct regular home visits and phone follow-ups to monitor progress and ensure ongoing support.

7. Document patient interactions and care plans in the electronic health record within 24 hours, and close all encounters.

8. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to address patient needs and improve health outcomes.

9. Identify and address social determinants of health and health disparities.

10. Provide cultural competency and linguistically appropriate services.

11. Maintain patient confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA guidelines.

12. CHW minimum productivity is expected to be 80% clinical (patient billable encounters) and 20% Non-productive (driving/documentation/outreach, etc.).

13. Schedule 75% of clients before the 15th of each month.

14. Conduct outreach for community awareness of the ECM program.

15. Attend regular staff meetings, training sessions, and other meetings as requested.

16. Minimum caseload of 25-30 ECM clients, and may increase during times when the clinic is experiencing a staffing shortage.

17. Minimum combined total of 20 CHW and ECM touches per month.

**Community Outreach:**

1. Initially, outbound calls will be made to individuals on the assigned referral lists to educate them regarding CHW and ECM services available to them under their health plan.

a. Insurance must be verified before services can be provided to ensure the client is eligible.

b. If the client’s need is minimal and can be addressed in the short term, a CHW touch will be conducted on the spot, such as providing resources or navigating a website.

c. If the client’s need is extensive and requires a long-term plan to achieve their goals, an ECM intake/successful engagement will be conducted on the spot.

2. Engage members in a respectful, culturally sensitive, and trauma-informed manner.

3. Accurately document outreach activity using standardized tracking systems, designated outreach platforms, and Dr. Cloud.

4. Track member responses, time spent, and follow-up needs in accordance with approved program procedures.

5. Schedule intake appointments and ensure appropriate follow-up to confirm member engagement.

6. Follow internal workflows for outreach outcomes.

7. Confirm appointment attendance and relay updates to care and coordination teams as needed.

8. Identify and escalate issues such as insurance discrepancies, invalid contact information, urgent support needs, or language barriers.

9. Participate in regular team meetings, compliance training, and performance reviews.

**NON-ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** Performs other duties as assigned. Ability to work independently and be self-directed and flexible. Ability to perform functions with minimal supervision. Ability to work at a high-volume level of accuracy.

**Requirements:**

1. A bachelor's degree in psychology, social work, human services, or a related field.

2. Community-based work, also known as in-vivo work, requires proper safety precautions.

3. Certification as a CHW (CCHW) or willingness to obtain within 18 months.

4. CPI and CPR within 30 days of hire.

5. Strong communication, interpersonal, and cultural competency skills.

6. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

7. Basic computer skills and familiarity with electronic health records.

8. Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (if applicable).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Certified as a CHW (CCHW)

2. Experience working with diverse populations and communities.

3. Knowledge of community resources and services.

4. Familiarity with care management software and technology.

5. Bilingual or multilingual skills.

**Working Conditions:**

1. Office and Community setting with frequent travel to client homes, community organizations, and healthcare providers.

2. Flexible scheduling to accommodate client needs, including evenings and weekends.

**We Offer:**

1. Competitive salary and benefits package.

2. Opportunities for professional growth and development.

3. Collaborative and supportive work environment.

4. The chance to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our patients and community

Assigned to several specific named customers, the Strategic Account Manager is responsible for winning new Antech customers, achieving sales quota and assigned strategic account objectives. The Strategic Account Manager represents the entire range of company products and services to assigned customers, while leading the customer account planning cycle and ensuring assigned customers’ needs and expectations are met by the company.
  
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  
Establishes productive, professional relationships with key personnel in assigned customer accounts.
  
Ability to develop organic opportunities with existing customers and develop new business relationships with emerging customers
  
Coordinates the involvement of cross-functional support across the company in order to meet account performance objectives and customers’ expectations.
  
Meets assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned accounts.
  
Achieves assigned sales quota in designated strategic accounts.
  
Meets assigned expectations for profitability.
  
Achieves strategic customer objectives defined by company management.
  
Completes strategic customer account plans that meet company standards.
  
Maintains high customer satisfaction ratings that meet company standards.
  
Completes required training and development objectives within the assigned time frame.
  
Proactively leads a joint company-strategic account planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones for a one and three-year period.
  
Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates customer needs on an ongoing basis.
  
Leads solution development efforts that best address customer needs, while coordinating the involvement of all necessary company personnel.
  
Ongoing monitoring of current market landscape for new business development related opportunities and challenges
  
Coordination of proposal process including document templates, standard text, quality assurance and document management
  
Management of broad Antech representation at select industry events.
  
The Strategic Account Manager will also be assigned other duties and tasks as required from time to time.
  
Work with internal functional teams by attending zone and regional meetings to facilitate the understanding of national account opportunities for growth and standardization of offerings by field team.
  
We share a collaborative obligation to ensure that we conduct ourselves in the utmost ethical manner and that we hold each other accountable to the values and standards of the organization. Every associate has the responsibility to ask questions, seek guidance, and report concerns and/or violations of company policy or ethical standards. Antech Diagnostics has several processes in place to communicate with leadership and expects that associates will have a commitment to integrity and uncompromising values.
  
Education and Experience
  
Minimum 4 years’ experience in animal health sales, pharmaceutical sales, marketing, or biotechnology experience
  
University Degree in Science or Management, post-graduate degree an asset
  
Proven ability to network and develop new business relationships
  
Proven track record with corporate veterinary practice groups, channel management or equivalent
  
Experience with contract negotiations
  
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  
Advanced knowledge of the veterinary pharmaceutical industry
  
Strong business and financial acumen
  
Strong analytical and mathematical skills
  
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
  
Effective interpersonal and leadership skills
  
Effective organizational skills; attention to detail
  
Ability to consistently meet deadlines
  
**Excellent problem-solving skills:** ability to resolve issues effectively and efficiently
  
Excellent presentation skills
  
Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and other Office Programs
  
Experience with veterinary practice management systems
  
Travel
  
Will there be notable travel in this position? Yes, approximately 50% of time
  
  
About Antech
  
Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training;

jobs.description:
QUALITY FIRST BUILDERS

Construction company is a growing design-build and general contracting company specializing in high-end residential remodeling, additions, ADUs, and new construction throughout the Los Angeles area.

We are looking for an experienced In-House SEO & Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of our SEO, website performance, local search presence, paid search campaigns, analytics, and digital lead-generation strategy.

We currently work with an outside SEO company, but our goal is to bring these capabilities in-house with someone who can work on our business full-time, understand our market deeply, and continuously improve our online visibility and lead generation.

This is a hands-on position. We are not looking for someone whose experience is primarily managing outside agencies. We want someone who can personally execute, analyze, troubleshoot, test, and improve our digital marketing.

Key Responsibilities

SEO Strategy & On-Page SEO

* Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy focused on generating qualified remodeling and construction leads. **Perform keyword research and identify opportunities based on search volume, competition, location, and customer intent.** Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, page structure, images, and website content. **Develop strong internal-linking strategies.** Identify content gaps and create strategies for service pages, city/location pages, project pages, FAQs, and blog content. **Monitor keyword rankings and organic search performance.** Analyze competitors and identify opportunities to outperform them in local search results.

Technical SEO

* Perform regular technical SEO audits. **Manage crawlability, indexing, XML sitemaps, redirects, canonical tags, robots.txt, and duplicate-content issues.** Implement and maintain structured data/schema markup. **Monitor and improve Core Web Vitals.** Identify and correct broken links, crawl errors, indexing issues, and other technical SEO problems. **Work directly inside Google Search Console to identify and resolve search-performance issues.**

Website Development & Management

* MUST know how to manage and maintain our WordPress/CMS website. **Create and modify landing pages, service pages, project pages, and location pages.** Strong understanding of HTML and CSS; working knowledge of JavaScript. **Improve website speed, usability, mobile responsiveness, and overall performance.** Understand hosting, DNS, domains, SSL, redirects, backups, and website security basics. **Work with designers/developers when advanced development is required.**

Local SEO & Google Business Profile

* Take ownership of our Google Business Profile. **Optimize our presence in Google Maps and local search results.** Manage categories, services, photos, posts, Q&A, reviews, and other GBP features. **Develop strategies to increase legitimate customer reviews.** Build, audit, and maintain local citations and directory listings. **Maintain consistent NAP/business information across the web.**

Link Building & Off-Page SEO

* Develop and execute ethical backlink-building strategies. **Conduct outreach for relevant links, guest posts, partnerships, mentions, and digital PR opportunities.** Evaluate backlink quality and monitor our backlink profile. **Identify competitor backlink opportunities.** Build relationships with relevant local websites, publications, organizations, suppliers, and industry resources.

Google Ads & Paid Search

* Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including Search, Display, remarketing, and other relevant campaign types. **Help manage and optimize Local Services Ads where applicable.** Perform keyword research, negative-keyword management, bid optimization, ad testing, and landing-page optimization. **Continuously monitor cost per lead, conversion rate, lead quality, and return on advertising spend.** Identify wasted spend and opportunities to improve campaign profitability.

Analytics, Tracking & Reporting

* Manage Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and conversion tracking. **Properly track phone calls, contact forms, booked appointments, and other important conversion events.** Build dashboards and reports covering organic traffic and rankings, leads by source, cost per lead, conversion rates, Google Ads performance, local/Google Maps performance, website performance, lead quality, and ROI. **Go beyond reporting numbers—we expect this person to explain what is working, what isn't, why, and what we should do next.**

Content & Copywriting

* Write and optimize website copy that is both SEO-friendly and persuasive. **Create or help develop service pages, landing pages, project descriptions, FAQs, blog articles, and location-specific content.** Understand search intent and how to create content designed to rank while converting visitors into leads. **Use AI tools effectively while maintaining original, useful, brand-appropriate content.**

Reddit, Forums & Community Marketing

* Understand Reddit culture, subreddit rules, and proper community engagement. **Identify opportunities to build organic brand visibility without spam or overly promotional posting.** Participate strategically in relevant construction, remodeling, homeowner, and local communities. **Identify additional forums, Q&A sites, Facebook/community groups, and online communities where our target customers are active.**

CRM, Lead Funnel & Automation

* Understand CRM systems and lead pipelines, preferably Pipedrive or similar platforms. **Help connect marketing sources to our CRM so we can accurately understand where leads originate and which campaigns produce actual sales.** Build and maintain marketing automations using Make, Zapier, or similar platforms. **Identify opportunities to automate lead tracking, reporting, follow-ups, notifications, and repetitive marketing processes.**

You’ll help drive Orrick’s innovative approach to talent acquisition and professional growth—making an impact at the local, regional, and firmwide levels.

jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator: Grocery & Food Rescue**

**Position Description**

**Location:** Irvine, CA

**Reports To:** Program Supervisor

**Status:** Full-Time, Hourly, Non-Exempt, $27.83 - $29.37/hour (DOE)

**Schedule:** Monday – Friday, 40 hours/week, Hybrid: in-office 3 days & remote 2 days

**Benefits**: We offer excellent Benefit Plans including incremental PTO Plan; 15 + Paid Holidays plus a Birthday Floating Holiday. 403b retirement plan with a match. Medical, Vision & Dental insurance plans with majority paid by employer. Life Insurance plan and Employee Assistance Program paid by employer.

Would you like to go to work knowing that every day you’ll be making a real difference in the lives of at-risk people in your community? At Second Harvest Food Bank of Orange County that’s exactly what you’ll be doing. Every moment of your workday will directly impact our mission to provide food for those who need it, when they need it. **Come join our upbeat, collaborative team who are improving lives every day by taking hunger off the table.**

**POSITION PURPOSE:** The role of the Program Coordinator is to manage the Grocery Rescue Program and Food Rescue donations. The primary objective of this position is to coordinate all Partner Network aspects of these food donation programs to ensure food-insecure individuals, families and students are being provided fresh, nutritious food at locations throughout Orange County.

The Grocery Rescue (GR) Program involves extensive coordination and support of our 75+ partners that pick-up food donations from 250+ local grocery stores via 900+ pick-ups each week. The GR Program is carried out in collaboration with our Food Sourcing Department and the food donors they partner with. Each month, nearly 40% of all food distributed by SHFB partners is acquired through the GR Program.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Grocery Rescue Program**

* Oversee all aspects of coordinating the Grocery Rescue Program in collaboration with the GR Program Coordinator and Supervisor, and as detailed in the GR Program manual.
* Primarily work with a portfolio of 40+ GR partners.
* Coordinate grocery store pick-up schedules with each partner and in collaboration with the SHFB Sourcing Department. Ensure all needed grocery store pick-ups are covered, or work with other SHFB departments to determine a solution.
* Troubleshoot GR partner challenges or store concerns as they arise. Follow feedback procedure.
* Ensure all GR pickup poundage receipts are submitted each week by all GR partners within assigned portfolio. Carry out corrective action procedures for late or missed reporting, as needed.
* Proactively look for anomalies in the data and seek answers from partners to address concerns.
* Develop, maintain, and cultivate new and existing Grocery Rescue partnerships.
* Train and supervise partners in assigned portfolio. Set proper expectations for program operations to ensure the program is always carried out by partner staff and volunteers.
* Conduct annual GR partner training and additional training as needed.
* Ensure partner compliance with program rules and regulations, as detailed in the Grocery Rescue Program Agreement – including food safety and reporting requirements.
* Carry out new GR partner onboarding processes.
* Conduct compliance site visits at GR partner locations, as assigned.
* Provide ongoing support to GR partners via email, phone calls and in-person or Zoom meetings as needed.
* Ensure all Program information in documents, files, and spreadsheets are kept up to date.
* Proactively look for solutions to partner challenges in executing the GR program. Including providing guidance and/or working with SHFB Sourcing department to overcome obstacles.
* Proactively look for ways to continuously improve the Grocery Rescue Program, including its effectiveness and how to better meet the needs of our partners.
* Demonstrate Service Excellence and Integrity when carrying out all aspects of program management.
* Actively participate in weekly team meetings and report updates, concerns, and successes in group meetings and at 1:1s.
* Attend webinars and trainings to increase food bank, food & nutritional insecurity, and Feeding America knowledge.
* Assist in collecting client stories for Grant Reports and various Development Department needs.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS/ENVIRONMENTAL FACTORS:**

* Ability to lift 25-50 pounds to carry equipment and supplies as needed.
* Regular driving throughout Orange County.
* Extended periods of sitting working on computer or on phone.
* Indoor office environment, indoor warehouse environment with moderate noise at food bank location.
* Up to 25% of time spent off-site at Community Partner locations and attending various meetings.
* Office hours are 8am – 4:30pm, but schedule varies based on department needs. Possible evening and weekend hours.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bilingual English/Spanish required (written and verbal).
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent job experience.
* Must have prior professional experience in non-profit, program coordination, or grocery retail.
* Must be proficient in Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* A professional who is reliable, proactive communicator and actively engaged member of the team.
* Self-starter with the ability, confidence, and good judgment to move projects forward with minimal supervision from direct Supervisor.
* Nurture strong professional relationships with coworkers, partners – current and potential, and external stakeholders.
* Excellent professional verbal and written communication skills. Communicate comprehensively with direct supervisors and the Director of Programs & Services on an on-going basis.
* Proven experience using logical reasoning to identify areas for improvement and to problem solve. Proactive about seeking solutions to meet program, partner, and team goals.
* Dedication to continuous improvement and experience with making changes that lead to improved results

Headquartered in sunny Ladera Ranch, California, SmartStop owns or manages more than **460 self-storage properties across 35 U.S. states, Washington, D.C., and 5 provinces in Canada**, comprising over 270,000 units and more than 35 million rentable square feet.

Our fully integrated team of more than 1,000 self-storage professionals is dedicated to delivering an exceptional customer experience and driving long-term value for our customers, investors, and communities.

SmartStop’s commitment to service excellence and workplace culture has been recognized with multiple industry honors, including being named to **Newsweek’s Best Customer Service Award** (2021, 2023 and 2024), earning the **Reputation 800 Award** (2022-2023), and being recognized as a **Top Workplace in Orange County** (2022-2024), an award based entirely on employee feedback regarding our culture, leadership, and values.

We’re growing fast — and we want you to grow with us.

**Salary:** between $26.50 and $28.00 per hour depending on experience + annual discretionary bonus

**Location:** 100% on-site at our Ladera Ranch, CA headquarters.

**Operations Coordinator Job Summary**

The Operations Coordinator supports the Director of Operations with all operational activities at the store level for all properties in the portfolio, to include both the US and Canada.

**Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities**

* Performs administrative duties in multiple systems to include, but not limited to, setting up new accounts/systems, updating sites and employees in various systems, resetting passwords, reporting, troubleshooting, and typing correspondences and reports.
* Maintains all aspects of the individual stores’ business licenses (local licenses and TRS licenses, DBAs, Stormwater, etc.) keeping them current.
* Performs the site-location, companywide credit card charge backs process from the individual stores and refunds, documents, and tracks all disputes.
* Works closely with Accounts Payable and Property Accounts to resolve invoice disputes.
* Coordinates external vendor relations within Operations Department (for example: site uniforms, trash collection, telecom, utilities, etc.).
* Assists the Property Accountants with specific vendor account discrepancies at the store level.
* Processes the utilities benchmarking submissions for entire portfolio.
* Acts as liaison between internet/phone vendors and store locations for set-up, trouble shooting, auditing, and invoice management.
* Manages projects relating to a variety of store-related projects, as assigned by management, to include, but not limited to, store signage and store photos.
* Receives customer/employee inquiry calls. Answers questions and concerns; follows through either to resolution or refers to the appropriate manager.
* Trains cross-functionally within all of the Operations Support functions.
* Assists the Director of Operations with the internal operating system (SSM/DASH) with both troubleshooting and system questions for store level and corporate level staff members.

**Qualifications Needed**

* High School diploma or equivalent required, Associates Degree preferred.
* Minimum two years of related experience required.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite or related software necessary to create and maintain reports and logs.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to perform well in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to multi-task well.

**Benefits**

* Competitve salary
* Health insurance including medical, dental and vision
* Ample paid time off
* Generous holiday schedule
* 401(k) with matching and no waiting period
* Employee assistance program
* Paid employee referral program
* Free car wash once a month
* A collaborative & fun work environment!

***Lead Together!***

Do you take real pride in the craft of operational leadership — the kind that makes complex enterprise relationships feel effortless to the customer and unlocks the growth teammates can see but not always reach? Are you the person who anticipates issues before they surface, orchestrates internal resources with quiet mastery, and gets satisfaction from making the machine work? **If your answers are yes, please read on.**

jobs.description:
Tustin, CA

H - Business – H - Business /

On-site

  

**The Company**

VeSync is a portfolio company with brands that cover different categories of health & wellness products. We wouldn't be surprised if you have one of our Levoit air purifiers in your living room or a COSORI air fryer whipping up healthy and delicious meals for you every night.

We're a young and energetic company, we've had tremendous success, and we are constantly growing our team. As we garner more industry attention — just check out our accomplishments and awards by CES Innovation, iF Design, IGA, and Red Dot — we also need driven and talented people to join our team.

That brings us to you, and what you'll be joining. Our teams are smart and diligent and take ownership of their work — they're confident in their work but know how to collaborate with open ears and a spirit of learning. If you're down-to-earth, approachable, and easy to strike up a conversation with, this may be a great fit for you.

  

**Check out our other brands**:

levoit.com | cosori.com | etekcity.com

  

**The Opportunity**

A new ecosystem at the intersection of wellness and technology, with a connected product, hardware and software, built to help people take an active role in their own health rather than simply measure it. The Social Media Manager owns the social presence behind that launch, from the first post through the audience we build.

Your job is to decide what each channel is for, build the content that fills it, and grow an audience from a standing start. You'll set the strategy and make the work, engage the people who show up, and build the credibility that turns attention into members. We are pre-launch, and the brand, the positioning, and the claims we can make are all still being built. You'll work alongside that, not after it. It's a hands-on role.

### **What you will do at VeSync:**

**Channel Strategy & Audience**

* **Own the Channel Strategy**: Define what each channel is for, the role it plays from first impression through consideration, and the goal it carries. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Threads, Reddit, and what comes next.
* **Own the Audience Build**: Grow the audience from a standing start. Audience and engagement growth are numbers you own, with an approach behind them.
* **Turn Positioning into Channel-Native Content**: Take the positioning and claims framework owned by Product Marketing and turn it into content that works on each channel, adapted rather than copied across. Both are being written now, so expect to work from drafts and adjust as they settle.

**Content & Voice**

* **Own the Calendar and the Formats**: Build the programming calendar, the repeatable formats behind it, and the production cadence that keeps it fed.
* **Make the Work**: Concept, write, shoot, edit, and publish. Creative and agency partners support you, they don't do it for you.
* **Hold the Voice and the Claims Line**: Keep a consistent brand voice across channels, and work inside the medical, regulatory, and claims review process rather than around it.

**Engagement & Performance**

* **Drive Engagement on Owned Channels**: Reply to comments, answer DMs, and take part in the conversation under our own posts. Route product issues and escalations to CX.
* **Show Up on Reddit and in Forums**: Hold our presence in the places this product gets discussed by people who know it well. These are spaces we don't control, and they reward participation over promotion.
* **Own the Numbers**: Set the metrics and KPIs for each channel, report performance honestly, and turn what the data says into what gets made next.

### **What you bring to the role:**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree required.
* **Experience**: 5+ years managing social media for consumer (B2C) brands, with hands-on direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience. Health & wellness, consumer hardware, and subscription or membership backgrounds are strongly preferred.
* **New Brand & Audience Build**: Proven track record launching a brand, sub-brand, or product line into an audience that did not previously exist.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity**: Can build while the brand, the positioning, and the claims framework are still being settled. Makes progress on partial information, changes direction when decisions land, and doesn't fill the gaps by inventing positioning of their own.
* **Platform Native**: Fluent in the craft and the culture of each channel and in how they differ. Comfortable in forums and communities you don't control, where publishing like a brand doesn't work.
* **Hands-On Maker**: Concepts, writes, shoots, and edits. Produces the content, not only the brief.
* **Claims & Regulatory Fluency**: Experience in health, wellness, medical device, supplements, or a similarly regulated space. Knows what to avoid, and how to say something true and interesting inside real constraints.
* **Analytical**: Sets metrics and KPIs, reads performance honestly, and uses it to decide what to make next. Able to argue engagement quality over vanity metrics and back it with evidence.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**: Partners closely with paid social, brand and creative, product, and CX.

### **Location:**

* This is an on-site, office-based role in Tustin, CA.

### **Salary:**

* Starting at $90K Annually

### **Perks and Benefits:**

* 100% covered Medical/Dental/Vision for employee AND spouse + dependents!
* 401K with 4% employer match (eligible after 90 days of employment) and immediate vesting
* Generous PTO policy + paid holidays
* Life Insurance
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* Critical Illness Coverage
* Accident Insurance
* Healthcare FSA
* Dependent Care FSA

jobs.title: Project Coordinator, Workplace Relocations & Events
jobs.description:
**Location:** San Francisco Bay Area client sites

**Employment type:** Independent Contractor (1099), project-based

**Schedule:** Flexible planning hours, plus nights and weekends on move and event dates

**Reports to:** Founder

**Compensation:** Based on experience

**About Shift**

Shift Project Management helps companies plan and execute office relocations, decommissions and workplace operations projects, turning complex workplace transitions into smooth landings.

Founded by relocation specialist Pete O’Keefe, Shift takes a boutique approach: a focused client portfolio, attentive service and hands-on project leadership from discovery through closeout. We work closely with internal Workplace, Facilities and Real Estate teams to coordinate everything from vendor onboarding and scheduling to move readiness and opening-day execution.

Our services include:

* **Relocations & Decommissions:** End-to-end planning, budgeting, vendor coordination and on-site oversight.
* **Workplace Operations:** Setting up new sites, onboarding and coordinating service vendors, and establishing operational processes.
* **Special Projects:** Workplace activations, event logistics, signage and environmental branding coordination.

We make complex transitions easier to manage through clear communication, proactive problem-solving and organized execution, so clients can stay focused on their business and employees arrive at a workplace that is ready for them.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Project Coordinator who enjoys hands-on work, changing environments and seeing a plan come together.

You will support all projects across Shift’s portfolio, attending scheduled moves and events to help supervise vendors, check placement and resolve setup issues. While Project Managers lead their assigned projects, you will provide consistent on-site support across the team.

This is an evolving role with room to grow into project management. You will learn how to plan moves, coordinate vendors and support clients while taking increasing responsibility for project workstreams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Move Preparation**

* Support site walkthroughs and prepare inventories, photographs and project checklists.
* Print and organize box labels, desk tags, signage and placement instructions.
* Hang signage and confirm rooms, desks and destination areas are clearly marked.
* Review move plans, floor plans and assignments with the Project Manager before each move.

**Site Supervision and Move Support**

* Attend scheduled moves and events across Shift’s project portfolio.
* Provide on-site direction to movers and support vendors within the approved move plan.
* Check that boxes, furniture and equipment arrive in the correct locations.
* Track progress, flag missing or misplaced items and escalate to the Project Manager.
* Support furniture load-out, staging and workplace resets for events.
* Keep checklists and issue logs current, with photographs where needed.

**Technology and Workplace Readiness**

* Coordinate with IT teams to confirm equipment placement and completion of disconnect/reconnect work.
* Use client-approved checklists to check workstation setup and basic technology readiness; refer technical issues to IT.
* Check shared spaces, supplies and signage before employees arrive.
* Support unpacking, organization and post-move requests, tracking outstanding items through resolution.

**About You**

You notice when a label is wrong, a box is missing or a workstation is not ready. You follow instructions carefully, ask questions when something is unclear and look for the next task without waiting to be prompted.

You enjoy being on your feet and working at different sites rather than spending every day at the same desk. You are dependable, comfortable speaking with vendors and interested in learning how to manage projects.

**Requirements and Skills**

* Experience in workplace services, events, hospitality, facilities, logistics or another role requiring organization and customer service.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow floor plans, labeling systems and checklists.
* Clear communication with movers, building staff, client employees and project teams.
* Basic proficiency in Google Workspace and comfort learning project tracking tools.
* Availability to attend scheduled moves and events, including evening, overnight and weekend assignments.
* Reliable transportation to client sites throughout the Bay Area.
* Ability to move throughout project sites during extended shifts and perform setup tasks such as posting signage and placing labels, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Prior move experience is helpful but not required. We welcome candidates who bring dependable follow-through and a willingness to learn.

**Growth Opportunities**

This role can be a long-term fit for someone who enjoys project coordination, with flexibility for greater responsibility for those interested in advancing.

Pay: From $30.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

**BAKER FLOORING AND SURFACES**

**Estimator / Project Coordinator**

Job Description

**Department**

Estimating & Project Administration

**Reports to**

[President / Operations Manager]

**Location**

Burlingame, CA (hybrid or in-office)

**Employment type**

Full-time

**FLSA / CA status**

[Non-exempt (hourly) / Exempt]

**Pay range**

$98,000 – $108,000 per year, plus performance bonus

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Estimator / Project Coordinator prices commercial flooring and surface services work, helps win it, and then carries each awarded project from contract through closeout. This role owns the bid and the project paperwork, working closely with Operations, which manages crews and field performance, and with Accounting, which handles invoicing and collections.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Estimating and Bid Management**

* Review incoming bid invitations, accept bids, and assign them to the appropriate estimator or division.

* Prepare estimates using takeoffs, vendor quotes, and the company labor rate sheet; keep the rate sheet current.

* Request and follow up on pricing from suppliers and vendors by phone and email.

* Incorporate drive time and overtime into labor pricing.

* Prepare RFIs, manage bid deadlines, and submit complete proposals on time.

* Enter each bid in Salesforce with the client project manager’s contact information and the latest proposal.

**Contract Award Review**

* Verify that the company’s legal name, scopes of work, and dollar values on each contract match the awarded bid.

* Confirm inclusions and exclusions are clearly stated and priced, including power/generators, floor protection, floor preparation, demolition, and adhesive removal.

* Compare scheduled days and work dates against the time required to perform the work.

* Track pre-lien notices.

**Project Coordination**

* Schedule job starts and project timelines with clients and Operations.

* Review contracts in detail, route them through DocuSign as needed, and negotiate or correct changes with clients.

* Obtain contact information for each client’s project manager and superintendent.

* Obtain insurance requirements from the general contractor or contract and coordinate certificates of insurance with the company’s insurance broker.

* Prepare, submit, and track submittals and samples through approval.

* Order materials for awarded projects.

* Attend Project Labor Agreement (PLA) meetings.

* Upload budgets, contracts, and project documents to Procore.

* Collect work tags from Operations, prepare change order requests (CORs), and track them through approval.

* Maintain budgeted production rates, using closeout feedback from Operations to refine future estimates.

* Complete project closeout documentation.

**Billing Coordination**

* Notify Accounting when billing milestones are reached, including submittals sent, materials ordered, mockups completed, stages of work completed, and final completion.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 3 to 5 years of estimating experience in commercial flooring, finishes, or a related trade.

* Working knowledge of takeoffs, labor productivity, and material costs.

* Ability to read and interpret contracts, scopes of work, insurance requirements, and prevailing-wage or PLA provisions.

* Proficiency with Salesforce, Procore, DocuSign, Microsoft Excel, and email.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

* Clear written and verbal communication with general contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Simpro or QuickBooks.

* Procore certification or formal estimating training.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

Work is primarily office-based, with occasional job walks and PLA meetings at active construction sites, which may require walking on uneven surfaces and wearing personal protective equipment. Bid deadlines may require extended hours during busy periods. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* Base pay: $98,000 – $108,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance bonus: 5% to 10% of base pay, tied to bid success at target margin, on-time submissions, and contract and insurance turnaround.

* Medical insurance, with the company covering the majority of the employee-only premium.

* 15 days of paid time off plus paid company holidays.

* 401(k) with a 3% to 4% company match.

* Reimbursement of necessary business expenses, including mileage and phone.

* $1,000 to $1,500 annual professional development allowance.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Convey**
----------------

Every growing company runs on an invisible operating layer: recurring work that crosses a dozen systems and still needs a person to move it forward. Convey is a digital workforce platform. We take that work off the team and give it to digital teammates that the company's own operators train and manage. Each teammate owns a responsibility from the first request to the finished result.

Customers like TelevisaUnivision, Savoya, and Strategus use Convey for work that stands between the business and its revenue. Strategus cut integration launches from three to six months down to under one week.

**About the role**
------------------

We sell to executives, and you'll create the rooms where they meet us. You'll own Convey's field events and event speaking opportunities, and make them the in-person engine of our account-based motion: executive dinners and roundtables, our own events, and the right presence at the right industry events. Working hand in hand with sales, you'll make sure every event starts from our target accounts and ends in meetings and pipeline.

You'll also build the team differently. Alongside the core job, you'll train and manage your own digital workforce on Convey. Those teammates will own the recurring research, tracking, and follow-up work that usually takes over a field marketer's week, so your time goes to strategy, experiences, and relationships. You'll be customer zero for the product you're marketing.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Event strategy and budget**

* Build and own the field events plan and budget, chosen around where our target accounts and executive buyers actually gather.
* Decide where we show up and how: sponsorships, hosted side events, booths, or not at all.

**Executive and hosted events**

* Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, breakfasts, and workshops around key industry events and in our priority markets.
* Create events we host ourselves, from small executive gatherings to customer and community events.

**Speaking opportunities**

* Source, pitch, and secure speaking slots for our executives and customers at events that reach our buyers. Partner with brand marketing on each executive's point of view and talk.
* Turn every talk into conversations with target accounts.

**Account-based execution**

* Partner with account executives and demand generation to build invite lists from target accounts, and run the outreach before each event and the follow-up after.
* Own the handoff: every attendee conversation reaches the right seller quickly, with context.

**Measurement**

* Track every event from invite to pipeline: target account attendance, meetings, and pipeline sourced and influenced. Report on it every week and cut what doesn't work.
* Keep event data clean in the CRM and marketing platforms.

**Vendors and logistics**

* Manage venues, agencies, production, swag, travel, and budgets, with the same bar for a 12-person dinner as for a 2,000-person conference.

**Your digital workforce**

* Decide which recurring field work to delegate. Examples include event research and calendars, speaking submission tracking, invite list building and account research, RSVP and logistics tracking, attendee follow-up prep, and post-event reporting.
* Train those teammates, review their work, and keep improving them as programs change.
* Share what works so it shapes how Convey markets with Convey and how we tell the story to customers.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 5+ years in field or event marketing at B2B SaaS companies with a sales-led motion that sells to enterprise executives.
* Executive events that produced meetings and pipeline, not just attendance. You can show the numbers.
* Experience running events as part of an account-based program, in close partnership with sales.
* Experience securing speaking slots and preparing speakers.
* A strong operator. You run budgets, vendors, and logistics without dropping details.
* Fluency in CRM and marketing platforms. You report on event results yourself.
* Comfort with regular travel.
* Real fluency with AI, and the urge to hand off whole processes rather than just doing pieces of them faster.
* Experience marketing AI or enterprise software platforms.

**Why join**
------------

* Build the field program for a new category from the ground up.
* Use the product to build your team. You'll know the customer's experience better than anyone.
* Help shape the marketing organization early.

jobs.description:
Healthcare is broken at the first step: patients can't find the right care, understand what it costs, or access the medications they need. Mochi Health is fixing this.

We're building an AI-driven marketplace that makes healthcare discoverable—connecting patients to the right providers, transparent pharmacy pricing, and affordable medications. Over the past few years, we've grown rapidly by combining clinical expertise with technology that actually works for real people, not just hospital systems.

Our platform does what legacy healthcare can't: it gives patients transparent pricing before they pay, personalized medication management that follows them across providers, and long-term access to their own medical records. We're proving that healthcare can be more affordable, more human, and far more intuitive than what exists today.

Join a team that's rebuilding healthcare from the patient up. At Mochi Health, you'll work alongside people who value bold thinking, inclusive collaboration, and getting meaningful work into the world. If you want to do the most impactful work of your career, this is where to do it.

**About The Role**
------------------

Mochi Health is a direct-to-patient telehealth company specializing in obesity medicine and expanding into primary care. With over 200,000 active patients, 500+ providers across 50 states, and a proprietary AI-enabled EMR, Mochi is building the infrastructure for a new model of virtual care delivery.  
  
Today we operate primarily on a cash-pay subscription model. Our Insurance & Payer Operations function is one of the company's most important strategic bets: building the clinical, operational, and technical infrastructure to accept insurance and unlock a new revenue stream, and it's the engine behind our expansion into primary care.  
About the Role  
  
We're looking for an independently driven, detail-oriented Operations Associate to support both our core clinical workflows and the buildout of our insurance program. This is a blended role: part of your time keeps clinical operations running smoothly, and part helps stand up and scale the insurance and payer side of the business as we grow.  
  
You'll learn the mechanics of payer contracting, credentialing, and compliant billing from the ground up, working closely with Clinical, Product, Care, and Data teams and our Insurance & Payer lead.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Optimize clinical workflows by identifying inefficiencies, implementing solutions, and improving care coordination.
* Analyze performance data using AI and other tools to track provider KPIs and drive data-informed decisions.
* Act as a key liaison for providers, gathering feedback and streamlining workflows, and keep provider content and training resources up to date.
* Support day-to-day operations of the insurance program, coordinating across the credentialing team, billing operations, and external partners.
* Help manage provider credentialing and enrollment for insurance panels, tracking timely enrollment and re-credentialing across the payer network.
* Assist with payer contracting: organizing contract and rate information, preparing inputs for rate discussions, and tracking expansion into new payer networks.
* Support a team of agents that review billing and coding, helping monitor their output, surface documentation gaps and denial patterns, and escalate issues that create compliance or revenue risk.
* Monitor claims and vendor performance against collection, denial, and claims lifecycle targets.
* Help keep the program aligned with CMS billing rules, state telehealth parity requirements, and payer documentation requirements, and maintain the related SOPs.
* Partner with Engineering and Product to translate insurance-program needs into EMR requirements, and help define reporting on key program KPIs.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 0 to 3 years of experience in healthcare operations, revenue cycle, payer operations, clinical operations, or a related analytical role. Health-tech or telehealth exposure is a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in a STEM or related field.
* Comfortable working full-time, in-office in our downtown San Francisco office.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to know how, when, and what to communicate.
* Experience working across teams and building relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure in an early-stage program.
* A team-first mindset: humility, collaboration, and partnership are key.

**Nice to have:** exposure to E&M or telehealth billing, familiarity with credentialing, payer contracting, or revenue cycle concepts.

* Get in early on the insurance infrastructure for a company at an inflection point, with the potential to transform Mochi's business model and unlock primary care at scale.
* Build a rare dual skill set across clinical and payer operations, with a clear path to grow into payer contracting and revenue cycle ownership.

You'll be the strategic partner for a portfolio of customers — helping them get real value from Cube, diagnosing technical problems, running QBRs with data leaders, and ensuring they renew and grow.

The "technical" in the title is real. Our customers are data engineers, analytics engineers, and engineering leaders. They talk in SQL, think in data models, and evaluate you on whether you actually understand their stack. You need to be credible in those conversations while also being the person who can walk into a QBR with a VP of Data and connect platform metrics to business outcomes.

This role reports to the Head of Customer Success.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own customer outcomes. Manage a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise accounts end-to-end — from onboarding through renewal. You're accountable for implementation, retention, adoption, and expansion within your book of business.
* Run strategic QBRs. Prepare and deliver quarterly business reviews that go beyond usage dashboards. You'll analyze deployment health, surface adoption gaps, build ROI narratives, and give customers a clear roadmap for getting more value from Cube.
* Get technical. Understand how customers have modeled their data in Cube, diagnose performance issues (pre-aggregation strategy, query optimization, caching behavior), and advise on best practices. You won't build data models day-to-day, but you need to read them, reason about them, and guide customers toward better architecture.
* Be the voice of the customer internally. Translate customer feedback into actionable product insights. Work closely with engineering, product, and solutions architecture to resolve issues and influence the roadmap.
* Drive adoption of new capabilities. Cube's platform is evolving fast — Analytics Chat, embedded agentic analytics, MCP integration, workbooks and dashboards. You'll help customers understand what's new, why it matters for their use case, and how to adopt it.
* Manage renewals and identify expansion opportunities. You'll own the commercial relationship alongside our sales team. This means understanding contract timelines, building the business case for renewal, and spotting natural expansion paths — more users, embedded analytics, additional environments.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

Must-haves:

* 5+ years in a customer-facing role at a data, analytics, or developer-tools company (CSM, technical account manager, solutions consultant, or similar)
* Strong SQL skills — you can write queries with window functions, CTEs, and cohort logic, and you can read someone else's SQL and spot what's wrong
* Experience working with technical stakeholders (data engineers, analytics engineers, engineering managers) and executive stakeholders (VP/Head of Data, CTO) in the same account
* Track record of managing renewals and driving account growth in a SaaS environment
* Ability to run a QBR that a data leader would actually find valuable — business narrative, not just metrics
* Familiarity with the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), transformation tools (dbt), and BI/analytics tools
* Excellent written and verbal communication — you can explain a pre-aggregation strategy to a data engineer and explain ROI to a VP in the same meeting
* Based in the US with availability for overlap with US business hours

Nice-to-haves:

* Experience with Cube or semantic layer concepts (metrics layers, governed data models, headless BI)
* Background in analytics engineering, data engineering, or BI — you've been on the practitioner side
* Familiarity with embedded analytics use cases and multi-tenant architectures
* Experience with API-first or developer-tool products where the buyer is technical
* Understanding of AI/LLM integrations in the data stack (MCP, text-to-SQL, agentic workflows)
* Comfort with light data modeling, YAML/code-based configuration, or git workflows

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive salary and generous stock options in a growing company
* Unlimited PTO — we actually use it
* Remote-first culture with coworking space stipend if you prefer not working from home
* Team offsites several times a year (locations rotate between the US and Europe)
* Professional development budget — training courses, books, conferences
* The chance to work on a product that sits at the center of the modern data stack and the AI-native future

**Interview Process**
---------------------

* Introductory call — 30 min with the recruiting team
* Hiring manager conversation — 45 min to discuss your experience, approach, and what you're looking for
* Take-home exercise — prepare and present a mock QBR using a provided data pack (~3–4 hours of prep + 30 min live presentation)
* Cross-functional interviews — conversations with team mem
