Who We Are
  
The Fund for Public Health in New York City (FPHNYC) is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization that is dedicated to the advancement of the health and well-being of all New Yorkers. To this end, in partnership with the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH), FPHNYC incubates innovative public health initiatives implemented by DOHMH to advance community health throughout the city. It facilitates partnerships, often new and unconventional, between government and the private sector to develop, test, and launch new initiatives. These collaborations speed the execution of demonstration projects, effect expansion of successful pilot programs, and support rapid implementation to meet the public health needs of individuals, families, and communities across New York City.
  
  
 Our Culture
  
We embrace a culture of learning, collaboration, innovation, and well-being, where open communication drives our impact.
  
  
About The Role
  
The GAC Fund Project Coordinator will work under the direction of the GAC Project Manager to administer the NYC GAC Fund portfolio. The GAC Fund Project Coordinator is part of the team primarily responsible for citywide efforts to promote and protect access to gender affirming care.
  
  
About the Program
  
Gender-affirming care (GAC) is recognized by major U.S. medical associations as medically necessary for many transgender and gender-diverse people. In addition, many transgender and gender non-conforming/non-binary (TGNCNB) individuals also need legal or practical assistance in updating their identification documents, combatting jobs or housing discrimination, or even accessing education or bathrooms. Research shows GAC is associated with reduced depression and suicidal ideation, and better long-term mental health outcomes. Denial of care or legal recognition of one’s identity increases risk of mental health crisis and unsafe self-treatment. Yet access has become increasingly difficult due to state-level restrictions, insurance barriers, and shifting federal guidance.
  
  
New York City has been an innovator and leader in sexual and reproductive health. The New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene has long followed the tenets of the Sexual and Reproductive Justice Framework which states that all people should have the power and resources to make healthy decisions about their bodies, including sexuality and reproduction.
  
  
As part of these efforts, the Health Department will develop and implement a new fund to contract with clinical providers to ensure access to care for youth in need of gender-affirming care. This funding will enable providers of youth gender-affirming care to address financial shortfalls resulting from any denials or reductions in federal funding and increase their capacity to ensure continuity of care for medically necessary hormone therapy for transgender youth in accessible and affordable care settings.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
**The GAC Fund Project Coordinator will:**  

* Conduct a landscape analysis of the New York City GAC provider network
* Synthesize service level and cost information to create a strategic plan and recommendations for fund administration to identify opportunities for funding.
* Assist with the planning, implementation, coordination and oversight of the contract administration activities for the GAC Fund, including:
* Work with the GAC Fund Project Manager to assist with developing, reviewing, negotiating and managing solicitation and contract-related documents including grant or contract proposals, scopes of work, evaluation criteria, contract amendments and budget modifications
* Collaborate with Finance and Administrative teams to monitor grantee/contractor performance and coordinate and communicate directly with grantee/contractors regarding contract deliverables and operational expectations to support successful contract performance and service delivery.
* Work with the GAC Fund Data Analyst to track grantee/contractor performance through regular review of programmatic data.
* Help with coordinating contractor meetings and execution, including logistics, agenda and content development.
* Serve as primary point of contact for current and prospective grantees/contractors.
* Help with the preparation of presentations and other written materials for internal and external audiences.
* Other duties as assigned to support the overall goals and mission of the department/organization.

Requirements
  

* A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college and two years of experience in grants management activities related to the duties described above; OR a master’s degree in non-profit management, public administration, public policy or other relevant field from an accredited college and at least one year of experience in grants management activities related to the duties described above.

jobs.title: Activities and Outreach Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Activities and Outreach Coordinator reports to the Program Director and is responsible for coordinating, facilitating, implementing, and supporting programs, activities, events, and community outreach initiatives across the Pride Center of Staten Island (PCSI).

This is a hands-on, cross-functional position that supports the Center's overall programming and operational needs. Responsibilities may include youth and young adult programming, older adult services, intergenerational activities, community education, workshops, volunteer engagement, special events, fundraising initiatives, and community outreach.

The Coordinator is expected to actively participate in program development and execution, build community relationships, facilitate activities, support organizational events, and maintain accurate program documentation. This position is not limited to one department, population, program, or funding source. The Coordinator must be adaptable and willing to assist across departments, provide coverage during staffing gaps, and take initiative in advancing programs and organizational priorities.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Program and Activities Coordination**

* Plan, coordinate, and facilitate onsite and offsite programs, workshops, recreational activities, and community-building initiatives.

* Support fundraising efforts, sponsor recognition, grant-funded projects, and organizational campaigns.

**4. Workshops, Education, and Volunteer Engagement**

jobs.title: Research Coordinator - CHASM Department
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering a career with the Research Foundation of The City University of New York (RFCUNY).

The team at RFCUNY is made up of dedicated, talented professionals committed to providing the services that allow CUNY researchers, faculty, and staff to focus on their intellectual curiosity and scientific discoveries.

We are pleased that you are interested in exploring opportunities to join RFCUNY.

Primary Location:

CUNY SCHOOL OF MEDICINE

Bargaining Unit:

No

The Research Coordinator will support the implementation and daily operations of *Our Stories, Our Bodies, Our Safety* , a community-engaged research project examining experiences of safety, community violence, mental health, and well-being among Black pregnant and postpartum women in New York City.

  

Under the direction of the Principal Investigator (PI), the Research Coordinator will oversee participant recruitment and engagement, coordinate data collection activities, maintain study documentation, and support community partnerships. The Coordinator will help ensure research activities are implemented efficiently, ethically, and in accordance with institutional and IRB-approved protocols.

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

**1. Participant Recruitment and Enrollment (25%)**

* Develop and implement participant recruitment strategies in collaboration with the PI.
* Coordinate outreach to community organizations, maternal health programs, and other recruitment partners.
* Distribute recruitment materials through approved community and digital channels.
* Conduct participant eligibility screening and coordinate informed consent procedures in accordance with approved study protocols.
* Maintain recruitment logs and track enrollment progress toward study targets.
Schedule participant research appointments and communicate study expectations.  

  

**2. Study Coordination and Data Collection (25%)**

* Coordinate administration of study surveys and scheduling of qualitative interviews.
* Monitor completion of study activities and follow up with participants as appropriate.
* Assist with distributing, tracking, and collecting Fitbit devices used during the 14-day monitoring period.
* Maintain accurate records of participant study participation and completion.
* Coordinate participant compensation and maintain incentive distribution records.
Identify and communicate operational challenges to the PI.  

  

**3. Data Management and Research Documentation (20%)**

* Maintain organized, accurate, and confidential research records.
* Assist with data entry, quality assurance, and verification of survey and participant tracking data.
* Manage secure participant databases and study tracking spreadsheets.
* Ensure research data are stored and handled in accordance with institutional confidentiality and data security requirements.
* Support preparation of research progress summaries and recruitment reports.
Assist with maintaining IRB documentation and protocol compliance.  

  

**4. Community Engagement and Participant Retention (20%)**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for participants regarding study logistics.
* Maintain culturally responsive, respectful, and trauma-informed communication with participants.
* Coordinate participant reminders, follow-up appointments, and retention activities.
* Support relationships with community-based organizations and maternal health stakeholders.
* Identify barriers to participation and work with the PI to develop appropriate solutions.
Assist with coordinating community engagement activities and dissemination efforts.  

  

**5. Administrative and Project Support (10%)**

* Attend regular study team meetings and provide updates on recruitment and project progress.
* Coordinate study schedules, supplies, and research materials.
* Assist with preparing reports and other grant-related documentation.
* Maintain study timelines and track completion of assigned project milestones.
Perform other research-related duties as assigned by the PI.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in psychology, public health, social work, sociology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple research activities and maintain accurate records.
* Experience working with diverse populations and demonstrated cultural sensitivity.
* Ability to maintain participant confidentiality and follow established research protocols.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar data management tools.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Previous experience coordinating research studies or supporting community-based research.
* Experience with recruitment, informed consent, survey administration, or participant tracking.
* Familiarity with maternal health, mental health, reproductive health, or health equity research.
* Experience working with Black women, families, and historically underserved communities.
* Familiarity with REDCap or other research data collection platforms.
* Knowledge of human subjects research protections and IRB procedures.
Experience with wearable health technologies or digital health research.  

  

**Supervision and Reporting**

The Research Coordinator will report directly to Dr. Brianna A. Baker, Principal Investigator, and will work collaboratively with other research team members and community partners.

  

**Expected Outcomes**

The Research Coordinator will contribute to the successful recruitment and enrollment of approximately 30 participants, timely completion of study activities, accurate maintenance of research documentation, strong participant engagement and retention, and successful implementation of the project's research objective

Minimum - Maximum: $20.00/hour

jobs.title: Account Executive | Inside Sales
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

Ramp's SMB sales team runs a high-velocity, full-cycle sales motion. We sell Ramp's full platform (corporate cards, expense management, bill pay, and procurement) to businesses with up to 150 employees, working with their founders, CEOs, and finance leaders.

In this role, you'll help small businesses find a better way to manage their spend and run their finances. You'll own each customer relationship from the first conversation through close: learning how the business operates today, uncovering what's slowing the team down, and showing how Ramp solves it. It's a fast-moving seat with a lot of customer conversations, so you'll sharpen your discovery and closing craft quickly and see your impact in every customer you bring on.

This is a role for a seller who has done the work at both ends of the funnel: someone who started their sales career as an SDR, earned a closing seat, and wants a much bigger volume of at-bats. You'll get coaching, a team that shares what works, and clear paths to grow into Commercial sales, Ramp's newer AI product teams, account management, or leadership.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the full sales cycle for SMB customers, from discovery and demo through pricing, negotiation, and close.
* Run 10–12 customer conversations a day while keeping a clean, accurate pipeline and forecast.
* Close at high volume (the team expects 50–60 new customers a month per rep once ramped).
* Self-source part of your business through daily outbound (about 10% of your closed-won customers).
* Run focused discovery with founders, CEOs, and finance leaders, and connect Ramp to the pain they describe.
* Learn Ramp's products and internal tools quickly, and adapt as products and workflows change.

**What You Need**
-----------------

* 2–3 years of combined sales experience, including at least one year in a quota-carrying, closing AE role.
* A start in sales development (SDR or BDR) or another outbound role, with a track record of self-sourcing pipeline.
* Experience selling SaaS or tech, ideally a product similar to Ramp.
* A track record as a top performer against quota.
* Comfort leading pricing and negotiation conversations.
* Strong organization: you can prioritize a large book of deals and keep each one moving.
* Comfort with change and ambiguity in a fast-moving, high-intensity environment.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience selling to executive buyers such as CFOs, CEOs, or directors of finance.
* Familiarity with finance or Office of the CFO topics (we'll coach this).
* Experience managing a pipeline in Gong or a similar deal board with forecast categories.

**Benefits available to all full-time Ramp employees (Global)**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Flexible PTO
* Centralized home-office equipment ordering
* Health and wellness stipend
* Budget for intra-office travel
* Weekly coffee stipend

**United States**
-----------------

* 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents
* One Medical annual membership
* 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp
* Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay
* Pet insurance
* In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more
* Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

**Canada**
----------

* Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life
* Life, AD&D, and disability coverage
* Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)
* Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay
* Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

**United Kingdom**
------------------

* Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite
* Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi
* Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option
* Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

**Referral Instructions**
-------------------------

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

**Other notices**
-----------------

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

*Beware of recruiting scams: Ramp will only contact you through official @**Ramp.com* *email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.*

Ramp Applicant Privacy Notice

Compensation Range: $165K

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

As a **Platform Technical Account Manager** at Integral Ad Science, you own the post-sales technical relationship for key clients. Your primary objectives are to drive efficiency and business value by helping clients fully leverage IAS's solutions, analyze customer workflows, identify opportunities for process improvement, and serve as a trusted advisor on best practices in digital media and ad tech environments.

**Note:** The responsibilities below reflect the core of this role today, but this is a fluid position, priorities, ownership areas, and day-to-day focus will shift as client needs and internal processes evolve. We're looking for someone comfortable operating in grey areas, without a fully defined playbook, and who can adapt accordingly.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Technical Advocacy & Service SLA Management:**  
  Serve as the main technical point of contact for key clients, delivering guidance on adopting and optimizing IAS' product offerings. Monitor and manage partner-specific technical support operations for IAS products and integrations to contractually defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and response/resolution metrics. Review and interpret client contracts to understand defined SLAs, obligations, and risk areas, and apply that understanding to prioritize work, escalate appropriately, and guide client-facing decisions.
* **Workflow Automation:**  
  Audit internal processes to identify areas for automation, recommending and implementing AI-driven solutions to streamline day-to-day work.
* **Proactive Support:**  
  Monitor client health and key metrics with insights; flag anomalies, preempt issues, and ensure clients are positioned for success.
* **Enablement & Training:**  
  Deliver training sessions and supporting materials to upskill client teams on new AI-driven features and integrations.
* **Continuous Improvement & Feedback Loop:**  
  Gather and relay client feedback to Product and Engineering, advocating for new automation capabilities and smarter workflows.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**  
  Partner closely with internal stakeholders across Business Development, Solutions Engineering, Product, Engineering, and Operations to support account growth, align on feature roadmaps, and resolve complex technical escalations seamlessly. Be able to work in non-defined roles and responsibilities to deliver results.
* **Client Travel:**  
  Occasional travel to client sites may be required to build relationships, deliver trainings, or conduct strategic technical reviews.

### **Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5+ years as a TAM, platform support, or technical client success role (preferably in ad tech or SaaS).
* Experience working directly at or with major social platforms (e.g., Meta, TikTok, YouTube) and managing ongoing technical operations.
* Strong understanding of AI/automation in digital media; hands-on experience using or implementing AI tools.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and client communication skills, with a proven track record of managing and meeting strict contractual client SLAs.
* Ability to translate business challenges into technical solutions, effectively collaborating across departments (Product, Engineering, Sales, BD) to achieve client objectives.
* Comfort operating in a fluid, evolving role with undefined or shifting responsibilities; adaptability is essential.
* BA/BS required.

### **Success Measures**

* **Client Satisfaction and Retention:** High client satisfaction scores and strong retention and growth of client business.
* **Operational Efficiency and AI-Implementation:** Measurable time savings and workflow improvements achieved for client support operations through implementation of AI tools.
* **Business Acumen in Practice:** Demonstrated ability to apply contract and SLA knowledge to day-to-day prioritization, escalation, and client management decisions.
* **Critical Thinking & Navigating Ambiguity:** Proven ability to operate in complex, undefined situations — applying critical thinking, building structure without formal guidance, and making sound decisions with incomplete information.

**IAS Pay Transparency:**

The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location, and any additional locations are listed below. Our pay ranges are based on the work location. As part of IAS compensation package, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes paid time off, health insurance (medical, dental, vision) as well as PPO, HSA and FSA options and 401k with employer matching contributions. All full-time employee roles include competitive compensation and are eligible for an annual bonus and/or other incentive plans. Each candidate’s compensation package is based on multiple factors, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need.

jobs.description:
**About HungryPanda / 关于熊猫外卖**

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London, HungryPanda connects overseas communities with authentic Chinese and Asian food through its delivery platform. We work with merchants and local teams to make great food more accessible while creating new opportunities for businesses.

HungryPanda is built by people who love food, enjoy solving problems, and value open communication and teamwork. As our advertising business grows, we are looking for an organized, dependable colleague who takes pride in getting the details right.

熊猫外卖成立于 2017 年，总部位于伦敦。我们通过外卖平台连接海外消费者与正宗的中华及亚洲美食，并与商家和本地团队携手，让美食更触手可及，也为商家创造更多发展机会。

我们的团队热爱美食，乐于解决问题，重视坦诚沟通与团队协作。随着广告业务的发展，我们希望找到一位做事有条理、值得信赖、注重细节的伙伴。

**About the Role / 岗位介绍**

We are looking for a hands-on Key Account Manager to help develop and deliver partnerships with major restaurant groups and consumer brands across the U.S. You will join your manager in important partner meetings and negotiations, then take ownership of coordinating the work needed to bring each partnership to life.

Because HungryPanda operates across the U.S., frequent domestic travel is a core part of this role. You should be comfortable traveling to meet partners and local teams, including overnight and multi-day trips.

我们正在寻找一位注重执行的品牌合作大客户经理，推动与美国各地大型餐饮集团及消费品牌的合作。你将与主管共同参加重要客户会议和商务谈判，并负责协调后续工作，推动合作真正落地。

由于熊猫外卖的业务覆盖美国多个市场，频繁的美国境内出差是这个岗位的常态工作内容。你需要前往不同城市拜访合作方、与本地团队协作，并能接受过夜或连续多日的出差安排。

**What You’ll Do / 工作职责**

* Prepare for partner meetings. Research prospective partners, gather business information, prepare meeting materials, and help shape proposals with your manager. 准备客户会议。研究潜在合作方、收集业务信息、准备会议材料，并与主管共同完善合作方案。
* Join meetings across the U.S. Travel with your manager as needed to meet partners, participate in discussions and negotiations, and document decisions and next steps.参与美国各地的客户洽谈。根据业务安排与主管出差拜访合作方，参与会议及谈判，并记录已确定事项和后续步骤。
* Follow through after each conversation. Coordinate answers to partner questions, track open items, and keep both sides informed so opportunities continue moving forward.持续跟进洽谈事项。 协调回复客户问题、跟进待办事项，并及时同步进展，推动合作继续向前。
* Turn agreements into action. Once terms are agreed, create an execution plan with clear deliverables, owners, deadlines, and launch requirements.将合作转化为执行计划。条款确定后，明确交付内容、负责人、截止时间及合作启动要求。
* Coordinate the launch. Work with Marketing, Advertising, Operations, and City teams across different markets to resolve issues and keep the partnership on schedule.协调跨城市落地。 与不同市场的市场、广告、运营及城市团队协作，解决执行问题，推动合作按计划启动。
* Maintain partner relationships. Serve as a reliable day-to-day contact, track commitments and early results, and identify ways to improve or expand the partnership.维护合作关系。负责日常客户沟通，跟踪合作承诺及初期结果，寻找优化和拓展合作的机会。

**What You Bring / 任职要求**

* Experience in key account management, brand partnerships, client-facing project management, business development, or a related role. 具备大客户管理、品牌合作、对客项目管理、商务拓展或相关工作经验。
* Experience coordinating a partnership or client project from discussion through execution, with a strong ability to follow through on details.有推动合作或客户项目从洽谈走向执行的经验，能够持续跟进细节直至完成。
* Confidence participating in commercial discussions and communicating with senior partner contacts while working closely with your manager on important decisions.能够参与商务洽谈，与客户方负责人清晰沟通，并与主管密切配合推进重要决策。
* Strong organization and coordination skills across partners, internal teams, deadlines, and locations. 具备良好的组织协调能力，能够同时管理合作方、内部团队、时间节点及不同城市的事项。
* Able and willing to travel frequently across the U.S., including overnight and multi-day trips. Able to work from the Los Angeles area when not traveling.能够并愿意频繁在美国境内跨州出差，包括过夜及连续多日的行程；非出差期间能够在洛杉矶地区工作。
* **Fluency in spoken and written Mandarin Chinese and English is required.必须能流利使用普通话和英语进行口头及书面工作沟通。**
* Experience with restaurant groups, food delivery, consumer brands, or local commerce is a plus.有连锁餐饮、外卖平台、消费品牌或本地生活行业经验者优先。

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads' vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. Our advertising opportunities include Lyft in-app homepage and in-ride products, off-platform audience extension retargeting, and IRL experiential executions. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we're looking for someone who's excited to help grow our partnerships.

As an Associate Account Manager, you'll report to the East Coast Account Management Lead and partner directly with Account Executives to plan and execute ad campaigns. You'll support campaigns from pitch through wrap, working across Sales, Ad Ops, and other teams to keep everything running smoothly. You will help improve processes and tools in order to facilitate better day-to-day operations and efficiencies for our sales team. We are looking for individuals who love solving interesting problems, are highly adaptable, and care deeply about customer satisfaction. As you grow, you'll start managing a few accounts independently and take on more direct client communication.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Pre-sales planning: Support sales team in RFP fulfillment and inventory management, including forecasting ad inventory against goals and checking takeover/events calendar.
* Data hygiene: Keep pitched and booked inventory and campaign data accurate across internal systems and CRMs.
* Post-sales execution: Own day-to-day post-sale tasks including smooth contract execution, creative services support, and campaign reporting.
* Cross-functional liaison: Coordinate with Ad Operations, Legal, Product, Engineering, and other teams to ensure all external and internal needs are adequately met.
* Ad campaign trafficking and optimization: Partner with Ad Operations to manage direct ad campaigns via internal planning tools and ad-server, including proper ticketing, set-up, scheduling, daily pacing and complete delivery based on Insertion Order parameters.
* Measurement and reporting: Build regular campaign reports and wrap reports, share insights with advertisers and internal teams, and support measurement studies where applicable.
* Billing: Coordinate with Lyft Billing at the end of each billing cycle on campaign totals and ensure invoices are generated and delivered to our advertising partners.
* Client relationships: Join the Account Executive in client and agency meetings to start building relationships, with the opportunity to take a bigger role in client conversations over time.
* Product knowledge: Learn and eventually become an expert in the full Lyft Ads product suite as well as targeting and measurement capabilities.

**Experience:**
---------------

* BA/BS degree and 2+ years of experience in digital advertising sales, media planning or campaign management.
* Proficient in Google Suite products, particularly Google Sheets and Drive.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
* Exhibits outstanding attention to detail.
* Excels at multitasking and is comfortable managing several campaigns throughout the ad life cycle at once.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for sales teams and clients.
* Consistently self-motivated and proactive in finding new solutions before being asked.
* Exposure to ad serving solutions is a plus.

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, AI Products - MCP Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

**Location**
------------

Hybrid: New York, NY (2-3 days per week in office). The office is located in Midtown West, less than a 10-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square.

**SHAPE THE FUTURE OF AI GOVERNANCE WITH USERCENTRICS**
-------------------------------------------------------

Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub.

As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections.

This is a category-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who wants to be on the ground floor of defining what success looks like for the companies adopting it.

**THE ROLE**
------------

As our Customer Success Manager, you will own the full post-sale relationship with MCP Manager customers: onboarding, adoption, support, renewals, and expansion. Our customers are typically companies of 200 to 1,000+ employees with active AI initiatives, and the people you work with day to day include VPs of AI, CTOs, IT operations leaders, and security teams. You will be the person who makes sure every one of them gets real, measurable value from putting their AI agent connections under governance.

You will work hand in hand with our Account Executives and Sales Engineer, and closely with our product, engineering, design, and marketing teams, inside a small, fast-moving group that operates much like a startup within Usercentrics. The role exists now because our customer base is growing and customer success deserves a dedicated owner. You will build the processes, health signals, and playbooks that let us scale it, and your insight from customers will directly shape what we build next.

**YOUR TASKS**
--------------

### **Onboarding and Adoption**

* Take over new customers at handoff after signing, building on the proof of concept and documented initial configuration they completed with our Account Executive and Sales Engineer, and guide them to broad rollout across their teams.
* Refine the success criteria agreed during the sales process into a success plan for each customer that ties their use of MCP Manager to the outcomes they care about, such as visibility, security, and cost control.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews that show customers the value they are getting and where they can go next.
* Bring in our Sales Engineer when customers need deeper help with technical configuration or troubleshooting.

### **Support and Customer Health**

* Respond to inbound support requests through chat and email within our response-time targets.
* Route technical issues to our Sales Engineer, and to engineering when needed, with clear context and reproduction steps, and keep customers informed until they are resolved.
* Build and maintain a customer health score that draws on product usage, engagement, and support history.
* Identify at-risk accounts early and lead proactive outreach before small issues become churn.

### **Renewals, Expansion, and Billing**

* Own renewals for your book of customers and forecast them accurately.
* Identify expansion opportunities, such as additional teams, servers, or plan upgrades, and drive them to close in partnership with our Account Executives.
* Process plan upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations in our billing and CRM systems so that customer records stay accurate.

### **Voice of the Customer**

* Capture and categorize customer feedback, and work with our Product Manager so that product and engineering can prioritize with real data.
* Close the loop with customers when features they requested ship or issues they reported are fixed.
* Build our customer advocacy program with marketing, collecting reviews, references, and case studies.
* Document repeatable processes and playbooks so that customer success can scale as we grow.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* You have 3 or more years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company.
* You have owned renewals for a book of business and have a track record of retaining customers and growing accounts.
* You are technically fluent: you can explain how software products connect to each other, run a confident product walkthrough, and work through configuration questions alongside technical colleagues.
* You communicate clearly in writing and in person with audiences ranging from hands-on administrators to CTOs and security leaders.
* You are highly organized and can manage many accounts, support requests, and internal projects at once without letting details slip.
* You use AI assistants and agents in your own work and are curious about how companies are adopting them.
* You are comfortable operating in an early-stage, category-creation environment where the playbook is still being written.
* Ideally, you have worked with customers in security, developer tools, data infrastructure, or AI software, or have hands-on familiarity with AI agents or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Ideally, you have built customer health scoring, onboarding programs, or other customer success processes from scratch.

  

**Benefits**
------------

* 401(k) plan contribution with employer match
* Commuter allowance (transit stipend)
* 18 paid vacation days (PTO)
* Health insurance
* Personal development budget

Are you highly organized and thrive in a fast-paced operations environment? We are looking for a **Operations Coordinator** to coordinate daily workforce scheduling, labor allocation, credential compliance, and timekeeping processes across the organization. The Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in keeping field operations running efficiently while providing accurate labor reporting and operational support to leadership.

**The Company:**

North Shore Neon is a leading signage company with over 70 years of experience, providing design, fabrication, installation, and maintenance services throughout the New York Metropolitan region. As a privately owned and operated, design-build custom sign shop, North Shore Neon offers turnkey solutions for a wide range of signage, including custom neon, LED displays, commercial, retail, and vinyl applications.

Queens, New York

**The Position:**

The **Operations Coordinator** serves as the central point of coordination between field operations, project management, and administrative teams to ensure workforce resources, equipment, and scheduling priorities are aligned with business needs. Working closely with project managers, supervisors, and leadership, this role supports operational efficiency, labor accountability, and workforce compliance while maintaining accurate scheduling, resource planning, and labor utilization data. The Operations Coordinator plays a key role in resolving resource conflicts and supporting the successful execution of projects and service work across the organization.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Lead the daily scheduling meeting with project managers, supervisors, and department leaders.
* Prepare and distribute daily schedules, work assignments, and resource requirements.

* Verify employees are properly certified and qualified before assigning work.
* Monitor employee timekeeping and work with supervisors and payroll to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate labor records.
* Enforce company timekeeping policies and address recurring compliance issues.
* Prepare and distribute weekly labor reports showing hours by job, crew, and employee.
* Monitor overtime, labor variances, and workforce utilization trends.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams), Google Sheets, and other business software applications.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to communicate effectively with field personnel, supervisors, project managers, and office staff.
* Ability to maintain confidential employee and company information.
* Knowledge of construction operations and field workforce coordination is a plus.

**Desired Skills and Competencies:**

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to coordinate schedules, labor, and resources in a dynamic environment.
* Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to hold team members accountable to schedules, deadlines, and company policies.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Leading sign company with over 70 years of industry experience and the opportunity to work on unique, high-profile, and large-scale signage projects.

* Paid Time Off

The salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000 annually, depending on experience. The final offer will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and skills demonstrated.

**Interested?**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected status established by federal, state, or local laws.***

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research**  
Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change.

At Adams Clinical, you'll find:

* A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity

If you're passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission-driven organization, we'd love to have you on our team.

**The Role**  
Adams Clinical is a rapidly growing research site network specializing focused on late phase industry-sponsored trials of novel treatments for a variety of psychiatric and neurological conditions, supporting both inpatient and outpatient studies.  
  
We are seeking experienced applicants for the Clinical Research Coordinator I role at our Bronx location. This role is ideal for early-career coordinators with some prior research exposure, looking to develop hands-on clinical and protocol management experience.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I is responsible for supporting and performing routine clinical research activities under the guidance of a CRC II or CRC III. The CRC I may independently manage lower-complexity trials (e.g., maintenance studies, extension studies) and serves as a secondary coordinator on high-enrolling screening trials. This role represents the first step in assuming ownership and accountability in study execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently coordinate low- to moderate-complexity trials, including scheduling, visit execution, and day-to-day operations.
* Serve as secondary CRC on high-enrolling screening trials, supporting screening, enrollment, and participant follow-up.
* Conduct participant visits per protocol, including medical/psychiatric history collection, vitals, ECGs, phlebotomy, and specimen processing, as trained.
* Prepare and maintain study source documents, lab kits, CRFs, and visit materials.
* Ensure accurate, ALCOA+-compliant documentation of all study procedures and maintain required logs, trackers, and regulatory files.
* Support investigational product (IP) accountability for assigned studies, including receipt, storage, dispensing, reconciliation, temperature monitoring, and documentation under supervision, ensuring compliance with protocol and site SOPs.
* Communicate with participants between visits to maintain engagement and protocol compliance.
* Assist with sponsor communication, monitoring visit preparation, and audit readiness as appropriate.
* Contribute to query resolution, data cleaning, and study metrics tracking to support accurate reporting and inspection readiness.
* Support screening operations and meet enrollment expectations for assigned study tasks.
* Prepare internal reports or summaries for review under guidance from CRC II/III.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* At least 6 months of prior clinical research experience. Experience with industry-sponsored clinical trials preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to continue learning hands-on clinical and research skills.

  

**Pay**: $27.00 - $33.00 per hour

**Benefits**:

* 401(k) matching
* Medical, Dental &Vision insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance

  

Adams Clinical is committed to being an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We focus on hiring and nurturing top talent. All employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, transfer, training, discipline, and termination, are made based on the candidate's or employee's qualifications relevant to the position. These decisions are made without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status.

In compliance with federal law, all individuals hired must, as a condition of employment, provide documentation verifying their identity and authorization to work in the United States and complete Form I-9 within the required timeframe. Adams Clinical participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant/Project Manager
jobs.description:
**This is a hybrid role, with an expected in-person presence in our NYC and MTK offices.**  
  
**About Falcon Rappaport & Berkman LLP:**

Falcon Rappaport & Berkman LLP is a full-service, rapidly growing, and entrepreneurial law firm focused on an interdisciplinary approach to the practice. Our team is composed of thought leaders across a variety of practice areas, including some of the nation’s leading voices on AI, taxation, and a variety of other fields.

We bring together experts across all of our departments to achieve extraordinary results. With us, respect, appreciation, and quality of life come first and foremost. We care deeply about the people we bring into our firm and offer a unique emphasis on professional development, marketing, and overall balance. We work collaboratively across the entire firm to drive client success.

**Position Overview:**  
The Project Manager serves as chief of staff to the Firm’s newly formed Innovation Office and acts as right hand to the Chief Innovation Officer (CIO). The office leads the Firm’s adoption of artificial intelligence, builds and deploys new technology and workflows, and supports the Firm’s AI practice. The Project Manager keeps the department’s priorities, projects, people, and commitments organized and moving, and extends the CIO’s reach across the Firm. The role also includes a client-facing component on the legal side, working directly with clients and supporting the business development activities of the department.

We are looking for someone who is exceptionally organized and who does not assume work has to be done the way it has always been done. AI tools are changing what one person can accomplish. The right candidate will use those tools every day, question existing processes, and redesign how work gets done, starting with their own.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Chief of Staff to the CIO**

* Partner with the CIO to set, track, and drive the department’s priorities, and own follow-through on decisions and action items.
* Manage the CIO’s time strategically, including calendar, meeting preparation, and travel, so that time goes to the highest-value work.
* Prepare agendas, briefing materials, memos, presentations, and reports for the CIO, Firm leadership, and the Management Committee.
* Serve as the CIO’s liaison to Firm leadership, practice groups, administrative departments, clients, vendors, and other external stakeholders, and represent the CIO in meetings as needed.
* Triage incoming requests to the CIO and the department, resolving what can be resolved and escalating what cannot.
* Handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.

**Department Operations and Project Management**

* Run the department’s operating rhythm, including weekly meetings, quarterly priorities, scorecards, and progress reporting.
* Plan, track, and manage a portfolio of concurrent initiatives, such as AI tool rollouts, technology builds, training programs, and vendor evaluations, from kickoff through completion.
* Maintain a single source of truth for department projects, deadlines, owners, and status, and surface risks and blockers early.
* Coordinate work across innovation team members, attorneys, staff, and outside vendors and consultants.
* Support budgeting, vendor management, license and contract renewals, and expense tracking for the department.
* Coordinate department events, trainings, internal build days, webinars, and speaking engagements.

**Reimagining How Work Gets Done**

* Use leading AI tools as a core part of daily work, and model AI-first habits for the department and the Firm.
* Examine department and Firm processes, identify where AI and automation can eliminate, accelerate, or improve work, and propose and pilot better approaches.
* Build and maintain practical automations, agents, templates, and prompts that save time for the CIO, the department, and the Firm.
* Document new workflows clearly so others can adopt them, and help colleagues learn to use them.
* Track and report on the adoption and impact of the Firm’s AI initiatives.
* Stay current on developments in AI tools and bring practical ideas to the team.

**Client-Facing Legal Practice Support**

* Interact directly with clients of the CIO and the AI practice, serving as a day-to-day point of contact for scheduling, status updates, and logistics.
* Schedule and coordinate client meetings, calls, and workshops, and prepare agendas, materials, and follow-up.
* Orchestrate business development activities for the department, including pitches, proposals, client events, webinars, and conference appearances, and keep follow-up with clients and prospects on track.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree preferred.
* 4+ years of experience in project management, operations, chief of staff, or senior executive support roles, preferably in a professional services firm (law, accounting, consulting, financial services, etc.) or a technology company.
* Exceptional organizational skills, with a proven ability to manage many projects, deadlines, and stakeholders at once without anything falling through the cracks.
* Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools to change how you work, with concrete examples you can share.
* Experience with project management and collaboration tools, and the ability to learn new software quickly, including the legal technology the Firm uses.
* Polished and comfortable in client-facing settings; experience supporting client service or business development in a law firm or other professional services firm is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clearly and concisely for senior audiences.
* Sound judgment and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.

***(Assignment Dates: December 1, 2026 - January 29, 2027)***

**About Robin Hood**

Founded in 1988, Robin Hood is a 501(c)(3) public charity that finds, fuels, and creates the most impactful and scalable solutions lifting New Yorkers permanently out of poverty in New York City. We convene philanthropists, civil society organizations, government, businesses, nonprofits, community members, and those living in poverty to develop and advance programs and policies that can make the American Dream real here in New York City.

  

Our investments include best-in-class organizations providing legal services, housing, meals, workforce development training, childcare, education, and other vital services that give New Yorkers the tools to build better lives. The programs it funds are often the first of their kind and serve as demonstration models to identify what works before being replicated in other cities. Because our Board of Directors covers 100% of all administrative, fundraising, and evaluation costs, every dollar donated goes directly to organizations helping New Yorkers in need.

  

While Robin Hood's primary focus is on New York, its impact extends far beyond the borders of the city. Its pioneering, metrics-based approach has become the gold standard for charities around the nation as Robin Hood works to understand and evaluate the impact of its partners to ensure that its philanthropic dollars are utilized to maximum impact. Robin Hood also supports its community partners and their leaders with financial and strategic support and management assistance that allows those organizations to maximize their impact.

  

Robin Hood also understands that if we are to support families living in poverty on the path towards financial independence, we must become an effective partner with government. We do this by collaborating with government partners to build program and policy innovations that hold the promise of expanding economic opportunity in New York City - providing nimble "risk capital" for high-potential strategies. We also work to advance public policies that research tells us expand economic opportunity. In this way, we seek to leverage our philanthropic investments by finding ways to advance the highest-impact strategies at scale.

  

Robin Hood has the unique ability to be a catalyzing force for those living in poverty, bringing distinct constituencies together to develop and spread the most effective strategies to advance economic mobility in New York City and beyond.

  

**Our Approach:**

• **Focusing on Results** : We invest in best-in-class organizations operating effective programs. We fund research to understand how poverty persists and what strategies are effective in fighting it. And we track grant outcomes and apply cost/benefit analyses to ensure every dollar we invest demonstrably improves the lives of low-income New Yorkers.

  

• **Building Institutions that Transform New York City** : We offer management advice, strategic real estate consulting, board placement services, financial and communications coaching, leadership development, and other technical assistance to help our partners increase scale and impact.

  

• **Driving Innovation to Solve Unmet Needs** : We invest in new leaders, new organizations, and new ideas that have groundbreaking potential.

  

• **Scaling What Works:** We partner with government and other funders to grow proven solutions in New York City and beyond, so more people benefit from investments that work.

The Temporary Fundraising Telemarketing Assistant (Part-Time) provides support to the Individual Giving and Engagement team in soliciting and thanking Robin Hood donors at the $1,000-$50,000 giving level. The Temporary Fundraising Telemarketing Assistant will report to MD, Individual Giving and Donor Engagement.

The Cabinet Design Project Coordinator supports the day-to-day movement of cabinet projects from intake and order through order release, installation scheduling, and closeout. This role is responsible for keeping project information organized, accurate, and current while coordinating communication between customers, designers, sales, vendors, warehouse, delivery, and installation teams.

* Maintain organized records that allow designers, sales, leadership, and operations to quickly understand project status and next steps.

Benefits:

* Paid time off

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Events & Logistics Lead, Phoenix Deployment
jobs.description:
Job ID: 530508

CRH's Americas Materials division is the leading integrated supplier of aggregates, asphalt, ready mixed concrete and paving and construction services in North America. Our operations span North America with over 29,000 employees at close to 1,660 locations in 45 US States and 2 Canadian provinces.

  

**Job** **Summary**

CRH Americas Materials currently has ~15 different ERP systems (from two separate software vendors - SAP and Viewpoint) and is on a transformational journey, named Project Phoenix, to move to a single ERP environment (SAP) with standardized business processes across the company. This will be a multi-year program with complex change management and implementation plans. The transformation includes the integration or retirement of a full suite of approximately 30 legacy applications spanning finance, operations, safety, HR, environmental, and other functional areas as those business processes move onto SAP S/4HANA.

The Executive Assistant, Event & Logistics Lead plans and supports in-person events for Project Phoenix. Reporting to the VP, Assistant GM, Phoenix Deployment for the project, this role coordinates logistics for training, testing and validation meetings held in multiple waves across multiple locations in the US and Canada. The role will also support the Phoenix team with administrative needs between events.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, budget conscious and comfortable managing large groups, multiple vendors and last-minute changes. Exceptional attention to detail is critical to success in this role.

This is a project-based role with travel of 50% or more.

.

**Job Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Logistics

  

* Plan and coordinate in person events from start to finish, including training, testing and validation sessions.
* Source and manage hotels, venues, catering, AV and other vendors, and coordinate contract review and approval.
* Manage hotel room blocks, meeting space and event materials such as name badges, signage and supplies.
* Provide onsite support during events, including setup, check in and issue resolution.
* Partner with IT and AV teams to make sure technology is ready for each event.

Attendee Management & Communications

  

* Maintain accurate attendee lists and manage registration, confirmations and follow up.
* Partner with Business Unit leaders to confirm attendee lists and coordinate changes.
* Draft and send attendee communications, including invitations, logistics details, agendas and reminders.

Budget & Administration

  

* Track event spending against budget and look for ways to reduce costs.
* Review and process vendor invoices and expenses accurately and on time.

Project Phoenix Team Support

  

* Support the Project Phoenix team with administrative needs.
* Manage calendars and schedule meetings and calls, including recurring team meetings and calls with Business Unit leaders and consulting partners.
* Arrange team meals, catering and working lunches as needed.
* Work with other assistants across CRH to coordinate schedules, meetings and events.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Identify and plan all business activities for each value stream related to technical cutover for assigned deployment waves.
* Work with the Data and Solutions Team to confirm technical readiness for business activities, including the SAP solution and integrated applications.
* Help the business execute the cutover checklist and track readiness status as the team approaches go-live.
* Engage directly with the business to provide direction and support for cutover activities.
* Support war room operations, including issue logging, triage, and status reporting during cutover windows.
* Monitor plan through SAP ramp up and start of Crawl, Walk, Run business processes.
* Maintain cutover documentation and provide regular status updates to the Business Readiness & Cutover Lead.
* Coordinate with project managers on testing, data migration, IT system cutover, and legacy business process transition activities.
* Document the cutover plan for assigned applications/workstreams, including dependencies and data readiness requirements.
* Plan the physical and virtual resources required for cutover activities and support legacy system shutdown coordination.
* Performs additional job duties as assigned by management.

**Qualifications**

  

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Five or more years of executive administrative or event planning experience, including events of 100+ attendees.
* Experience negotiating and managing hotel, venue and vendor contracts.
* Experience managing budgets and invoicing.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams).
* Experience with Concur travel and expense preferred.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to last-minute changes and work both independently and as part of a team.
* Professional presence and the ability to work with executives, consultants and vendors.

**Work Environment**

  

* Travel of 50% or more, often for one to four weeks at a time.
* Early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends may be required around events.
* Ability to lift and move event supplies up to 25 lbs.
* When not traveling, the role is preferred to be based in Atlanta, Georgia (TBD).

Other duties may be assigned as required. Requirements for this job are subject to modification by the Company and its designees, and reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

jobs.title: Aviation Warehouse Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Location**
------------

Atlanta, GA

**Employment Type**
-------------------

Full time

**Location Type**
-----------------

On-site

**Department**
--------------

Operations

**Compensation**
----------------

* $21 – $24 per hour

Where you fall within the compensation range is based on how you demonstrate the attributes and competencies required for the role. We mostly reserve the upper half of our compensation bands for internal growth. During your call with one of our recruiters, they can further clarify the salary range and our total compensation.

Overview

**The Problem**
---------------

Deployments for Flock’s aviation hardware are expanding across communities as more agencies adopt drone technology. Delivering those systems reliably requires hands-on warehouse operations that turn dozens of complex sub-components into complete, field-ready hardware packages. You will keep this pipeline moving, preparing every order so field technicians have every cable, mount, and assembly ready to install out of the box.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Assemble Dock 3 units and associated platform hardware to prepare each system for field deployment.
* Kit and package customer-facing orders of up to 50 individual SKUs, including specialized cables, mounts, and accessories, with precise attention to detail.
* Manage inbound and outbound logistics by receiving shipments, staging materials, and coordinating timely freight handoffs.
* Maintain accurate stock records by serializing all received aviation hardware and conducting regular cycle counts.
* Operate warehouse equipment safely, including forklifts and pallet jacks, to stage inventory and maintain an organized workspace.
* Respond promptly to tactical updates and shipping requests across internal communication channels to prevent deployment delays.

**What This Role is Not**
-------------------------

* This is not a specialized single-function warehouse position; you will handle receiving, assembly, kitting, inventory tracking, and shipping across the entire aviation product line.
* This is not a remote or desk role, as daily work takes place on-site in the warehouse preparing physical equipment.
* This isn't a software flashing or firmware role, as your responsibilities center on physical hardware assembly, kitting, and material movement.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Experience working in warehouse logistics, high-volume order fulfillment, or technology hardware distribution.
* Familiarity managing a large variety of complex SKUs and multi-part hardware kits.
* Experience operating standard warehouse equipment such as forklifts and pallet jacks.
* Strong responsiveness across written communication tools like Slack and email to coordinate rapidly moving orders.
* Ability to work autonomously and manage daily warehouse operations independently when needed.

**Compensation**
----------------

In this role, you’ll receive a starting hourly range between $21 and $24 as well as Flock Safety Stock Options. Base pay is determined by job-related experience, education/training, as well as market indicators. Your recruiter will discuss this in-depth with you during our first chat.

**Why Flock**
=============

Every community deserves to be safe. Flock builds the technology that makes that real: last year we supported over 1 million criminal investigations and helped locate more than 10,000 missing people. We're 1,700 people building the impossible with over $1B in funding, and the expectations are high on purpose. If you want a role where the stakes are real and the pace matches, this is it.

Some problems get solved faster in the same room, so we prioritize candidates in Atlanta and Boston. Hub-based roles mean real in-person time with your coworkers. Remote roles exist, and when a posting is open to remote work, it says so.

The impossible takes every kind of mind. Flock is an equal opportunity employer, and we know the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, experiences, and skills working together with mutual respect. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.

On compensation. We pay fairly for the work. Base salary is determined by job-related experience, education, training, and market indicators. The range in this posting covers base salary only and doesn't include equity, sales bonus plans where applicable, or benefits. The range may be adjusted over time, and this posting may span more than one career level.

One last thing. All legitimate communication from Flock comes from an email ending in @flocksafety.com or noreply@ashbyhq.com. We never make offers through messaging apps or third parties, and we never request payment or sensitive personal information during hiring. If you encounter suspicious outreach about a Flock role, report it to recruiting@flocksafety.com.

jobs.description:

#### **NOW HIRING**

Part-Time Community Liaison & Business Development Coordinator

Location: Metro Atlanta, GA

Position Type: Part-Time | 15–20 Hours Per Week

Schedule: Flexible Weekdays | Primarily Field-Based

Compensation: Competitive Hourly Pay + Performance Incentives

#### **About the Position**

Avanta Care is seeking an energetic, professional, and results-driven Community Liaison & Business Development Coordinator to expand our presence throughout Metro Atlanta.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys networking, building professional relationships, and connecting families with quality home care services.

We are looking for a confident, independent professional who can represent Avanta Care in the community, develop strong referral partnerships, and contribute directly to business growth.

This is a relationship-building and client acquisition position, not a traditional social media marketing role.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

Community Outreach & Relationship Development

* Conduct inperson visits to hospitals, rehabilitation centers, assisted living facilities, memory care communities, and senior organizations.
* Establish relationships with discharge planners, social workers, case managers, and healthcare professionals.
* Identify and develop new referral partnerships.
* Represent Avanta Care at community events, networking functions, and professional meetings.
* Promote our privatepay, longterm care insurance, and VA Community Care services.

Business Development & Client Growth

* Generate qualified referrals and prospective client inquiries.
* Schedule meetings and presentations with potential referral partners.
* Identify opportunities to expand services within existing markets.
* Maintain consistent communication with referral sources.
* Work closely with leadership and client services to support client acquisition.

#### **Marketing & Reporting**

* Maintain an organized database of referral contacts and outreach activities.
* Track leads, followups, meetings, and referral outcomes.
* Provide weekly activity and business development reports.
* Assist with marketing campaigns, promotional materials, and community awareness initiatives.

#### **Qualifications**

* Experience in home care, healthcare marketing, senior living, community outreach, or business development preferred.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Comfortable approaching new organizations and establishing professional relationships.
* Strong organizational and followup skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage a flexible schedule.
* Reliable transportation and willingness to travel throughout Metro Atlanta.
* Experience with CRM systems is a plus.

#### **Performance Expectations**

#### **The successful candidate will be expected to:**

* Develop 1015 new professional contacts weekly.
* Complete 2025 referral followups weekly.
* Schedule 35 business development meetings weekly.
* Maintain an active pipeline of qualified referral opportunities.
* Contribute to measurable growth in client inquiries and new service starts.

Performance will be evaluated based on relationship development, consistent outreach, referral activity, and overall contribution to business growth.

#### **Who We’re Looking For**

We want someone who is not afraid to walk into a hospital, introduce themselves to a discharge planner, or sit down with a senior living director to explain how Avanta Care can support their clients and families.

The right person is polished, personable, persistent, resourceful, and genuinely enjoys connecting with people.

We are not simply looking for someone to market our services. We are looking for someone who can open doors, build relationships, and create opportunities for growth.

#### **What We Offer**

* Flexible parttime schedule
* Competitive hourly compensation
* Performancebased incentive opportunities
* Supportive leadership
* Opportunity for professional growth
* Potential to transition into a larger business development role as the company expands

#### **How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume highlighting relevant experience in healthcare, community outreach, relationship management, or business development.

#### **Avanta Care**

Building Relationships. Connecting Families. Growing With Purpose.

#### **About Avanta Care LLC**

At Avanta Care, we are committed to delivering compassionate, personalized home health care that enhances the quality of life for our clients. With a focus on dignity, comfort, and trust, our team of skilled caregivers and nurses provide tailored care solutions to meet individual needs. We work closely with families to ensure peace of mind, offering services that range from daily support to specialized medical care, all within the comfort of home. Avanta Care is dedicated to being your trusted partner in providing exceptional care.

jobs.title: Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
Johnson Service Group is looking for an **Account Coordinator** who will be an integral part of the staffing delivery and account management process. By taking ownership of administrative, coordination, reporting, and operational responsibilities, this role helps improve productivity, strengthen internal communication, enhance client service, and allow Account Managers and recruiters to focus on their primary revenue generating responsibilities.  
  
**Account Coordinator** **Key Responsibilities:**  
**1. Account Management and Recruiting Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to ensure efficient management of client accounts.
* Serve as a point of contact for routine client requests, questions, and follow-ups, escalating issues to the appropriate Account Manager when necessary.
* Coordinate client interviews, meetings, and scheduling between clients, recruiters, and candidates.
* Assist with daily client coverage reporting and tracking.
* Monitor account activity and outstanding action items to ensure timely follow-up.
* Support client onboarding, documentation, and other account-related administrative requirements.

* Assist the management team with administrative coordination of open job requisitions and recruiting activities.
* Manage and distribute new job orders received from on-site teams and Aviation Department
* Coordinate the processing and assignment of new job requisitions to the appropriate recruiting teams.
* Create, manage, and maintain job postings across various platforms, including JS Firm, Indeed, and other applicable job boards.
* Coordinate interview scheduling and communication between clients, recruiters, and candidates.
* Monitor recruiting activity and follow up on outstanding requisitions and submissions.
* Assist with preparing open requisition reports and recruiting activity summaries.

**2. Reporting & Tracking**

* Monitor daily tracking reports to identify outstanding items, potential delays, and areas requiring follow-up.
* Prepare and distribute daily client coverage reports.
* Generate open requisition, recruiting activity, and other account-specific reports as needed.
* Maintain accurate reporting data and ensure timely updates.
